### Story 5.1: Resolve my configured approval route and explain setup problems

**Same-person refinement — accepted 2026-10-22, L-0158:** One confirmation covers
consecutive same-person steps with current authority for each under applicable policy.
Record responsibilities covered. Configured distinct-person requirements instead flag
invalid same-person routing and require an eligible replacement. Preserve self-approval,
completed history and every independent gate; exact representation/contracts stay open.

**Routing refinement — 2026-10-21:** P-0060/L-0147 replaces the old requirement to
freeze unfinished supervisor assignees until manual transfer. The route check remains
provisional; actual submission records required steps/policy and effective supervisor
changes transfer unfinished supervisor steps to an eligible replacement, preserving
completed/independently selected final steps and existing decision attribution.

**Scope approved — 2026-10-18, with requester-availability clarification. Not
implementation-ready.** Group 1/10; first agreed E5 scope. No final story count,
atomic coverage or sizing/readiness PASS inferred.

As an employee preparing a leave request,
I want Leave to check my configured approval route and explain any setup problem,
So that I know whether approval can proceed while my unfinished input remains saved.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an applicable one-step policy,
**When** Leave checks the configured route,
**Then** it resolves the configured approver from current organization-scoped
employment/access information,
**And** a supervisor relationship alone grants no approval authority.

**Given** an applicable two-step policy,
**When** Leave checks the route,
**Then** it resolves the supervisor step and explicitly configured eligible final
approver without assuming the CEO or silently dropping a required step.

**Given** a definitively missing or invalid configured route,
**When** the check completes,
**Then** show Your approval route needs to be set up and direct the employee to the
Leave Manager, exposing the issue through authorized setup assessment,
**And** preserve input and ordinary draft-saving availability; claim Draft saved
only after confirmed persistence. Submission later consumes this blocking result.

**Given** a required owner cannot supply a trustworthy observation,
**When** route verification fails,
**Then** return a safe retryable verification failure rather than missing-configuration
or valid-route claims,
**And** do not erase input or selections because of an outage.

**Given** the requester occupies a configured approval position or the same person
occupies consecutive positions,
**When** the route is evaluated,
**Then** enforce explicit self-approval and supported identical-step configuration,
**And** never silently satisfy another person's required decision or infer authority
from the reporting relationship. L-0158 now defines one confirmation covering both
currently authorized consecutive positions, unless configuration requires two distinct
people; exact configuration/representation remains a contract gate.

**Given** known approver absence or an applicant approval-responsibility coverage gap,
**When** route observations are classified,
**Then** distinguish those conditions from a missing configured route,
**And** do not claim this story implements temporary authority, fallback or coverage
execution; group 2 extends these rules before dependent submission behavior.

**Given** requester-facing approval information,
**When** the summary or optional workflow details are displayed,
**Then** retain concise Approval required wording with permitted process/decision
information on demand,
**And** do not expose approver availability, absence reasons or internal cover
arrangements, or assign the requester a task to find cover/chase an approver.
A genuine missing-route blocker and actions actually required from the requester
remain visible. The applicant's own approval-responsibility coverage is separate.
Authorized decision history retains its existing visibility and attribution.

**Given** a successful provisional route check,
**When** editing continues or shared facts later change,
**Then** the check grants no authority, reserves no entitlement and guarantees no
later submission result,
**And** it neither persists a submitted workflow nor silently changes existing request
assignments. Group 4 rechecks and records the actual submission snapshot.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §7/10, Permissions and current
requester-detail clarification; Leave ADR-0007/0071/0082 and current shared authority
rules; spine AD-2/4/7/8/12; BIZ-16/19, FLOW-01–04/07 and applicable PRIV-06/10/11/22.
Observe failing acceptance before authorized implementation. Cover one/two steps,
missing/ineligible supervisor/final approver, organization isolation/revoked access,
self-approval/duplicate identities, unavailable-owner retry, preserved draft input and
requester API/UI disclosure. Actual temporary-authority/absence execution and submission
snapshot persistence belong to their later consumers. Test paths/commands remain open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind actual E2 People/Access and E3 policy contracts,
route-observation schema and freshness, safe error mapping, exact configured duplicate
handling and authorized setup-assessment integration. Base configured-route read and
feedback must work independently of future request writes. Reconcile detailed size
before readiness; no new employee directory, policy editor or approval engine.

**Impacts:** Scaffold/shared UI: reuse proven current-access clients, loading/error/
retry and setup-feedback patterns; promote only a proven domain-neutral gap with this
consumer. Routing remains Leave-owned. Agent context: existing rules suffice.
Documentation: features/Leave EXPERIENCE clarify requester disclosure; epics, tracker
and handoff record approval. ADR: interpretation of existing concise summary/privacy
and role rules, no accepted decision amended or new ADR proposed. No application
code, tests, migrations, provider changes, deployment or implementation authorization.


### Story 5.2: Check temporary-approver eligibility and authority limits

**First-read allocation reconciled — 2026-10-25:** Minimum appointment representation, current interval/overlap reads and native constraints
belong here as their first actual reader. 5.23-A retains due-work/expiry/conditional return;
5.21/22 retain production management commands. No management UI or create API is added.

**Person-first clarification approved — 2026-10-21:** An authorized manager selects
an intended colleague, responsibilities and dates, usually after discussion between
the departing approver and/or supervisor. Leave validates that choice and explains
conflicts. No automatic substitute search, ranking, recommendation or appointment;
suggesting a colleague conveys no appointment authority. Membership/absence/conflict
checks and all existing scope limits remain binding.

**Scope approved — 2026-10-18, including clarified verification failure wording. Not
implementation-ready.** Group 2/10. This establishes checks, not a partially delivered
appointment confirmation UI or a new permission grant from preview.

As an authorized Leave Manager,
I want Leave to check a proposed temporary approver against responsibilities and dates,
So that cover is arranged with clear, limited authority.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an authorized manager selecting a temporary approver,
**When** eligibility is checked,
**Then** permit an active member of the same organization without requiring a permanent
Approver role,
**And** Organization Administrator status alone does not authorize appointment.

**Given** selected responsibilities and dates,
**When** the proposal is checked,
**Then** identify the original approver, responsibilities covered and exact period,
including supervisor or final-step responsibilities where authorized.

**Given** known absence, inactive membership or a self-approval conflict,
**When** eligibility is evaluated,
**Then** identify affected dates or decisions and do not treat that person as valid
cover for those conflicts. Request-specific conflicts do not imply unrelated authority.

**Given** another temporary assignment for the same responsibilities,
**When** the proposed dates overlap,
**Then** show the conflict and require adjusted dates or a separate authorized replacement,
**And** permit sequential assignments rather than silently choosing between overlaps.

**Given** a valid recorded appointment,
**When** effective temporary authority is checked,
**Then** allow only its specified responsibilities during its effective period, subject
to current membership and request-level checks,
**And** authority ends at expiry even if a return-processing job is delayed.

**Given** temporary approval authority,
**When** other permissions are evaluated,
**Then** it grants no permanent role, unrelated approval powers, on-behalf editing or
separate medical-document access.

**Given** a required eligibility check fails temporarily,
**When** Leave cannot confirm membership or check known absence,
**Then** explain that verification could not finish and offer Retry,
**And** do not confirm the appointment until those checks succeed. A successful check
finding no recorded absence is a normal result, not unavailable information.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §10/Permissions; Leave ADR-0077/0079/
0082 and current shared access rules; spine AD-2/7/12; BIZ-21, FLOW-14/15/17 and applicable
privacy/current-authority requirements. Observe failing acceptance before authorized
implementation; verify same-organization active member without permanent role, denied
appointment authority, scoped original/responsibility/date identity, sequential/overlap
cases, known absence and self-conflict, exact start/expiry boundaries, membership loss,
delayed timer without extended authority, no unrelated/document grants, dependency outage
versus successful no-absence result. Exact test paths/commands remain open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind restricted Access/People observations and authorized
absence reads, responsibility identity, appointment evidence representation, organization
and date/timezone boundaries, conflict mapping and current-action enforcement. Checks
must execute against trustworthy owner inputs; unknown inputs do not become eligibility.
No automatic appointment, transferred pending task, scheduled-return execution or temporary
approver acceptance step is introduced here. Later full management/transfer consumers
must integrate actual checks and their own concurrency/audit/outbox evidence before
activation; fixtures here do not prove those writes. Final sizing/readiness remain open.

**Impacts:** Scaffold/shared UI: reuse proven scoped member/date selection and safe
verification/retry controls, promoting only proven domain-neutral gaps at first use.
Leave owns temporary responsibility/eligibility semantics. Agent context: existing rules
suffice. Documentation: epics, tracker and handoff approval/clarification; existing
features/UX already supply these rules. ADR: accepted decisions unchanged. No code,
tests, migration, active grant, deployment or implementation authorization.


### Story 5.3: Check approval coverage throughout an applicant's absence

**Scope approved — 2026-10-21, with person-first clarification. Not implementation-
ready.** Group 2/10. Coverage assessment checks explicit human-selected arrangements
and valid configured policy fallback; it reports gaps, never selects replacement people.

As an authorized Leave Manager or assigned approver,
I want Leave to identify approval responsibilities uncovered during an applicant's absence,
So that cover can be arranged before final approval.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an applicant with no approval responsibilities,
**When** coverage is checked,
**Then** no approval-coverage condition applies.

**Given** an applicant with approval responsibilities,
**When** coverage is checked,
**Then** assess every relevant responsibility throughout the absence, including new
work that may arrive rather than only requests already waiting.

**Given** eligible temporary appointments,
**When** their combined periods cover the responsibilities,
**Then** recognize complete coverage, including sequential appointments,
**And** identify uncovered dates/responsibilities precisely where coverage is incomplete.

**Given** an explicitly enabled absence policy,
**When** an eligible final approver may handle the supervisor's responsibilities alone,
**Then** recognize that coverage without demanding a duplicate temporary supervisor,
**And** recognize an eligible temporary final approver under the same applicable policy
without a separate appointment fallback flag (ADR-0146); other responsibilities still
need cover. Actual fallback rule evaluation must be delivered
before this composition is claimed complete, not inferred from an appointment label.

**Given** incomplete coverage,
**When** an employee submits,
**Then** allow submission if other submission rules pass,
**And** when approval would become final, block finalization unless coverage is complete
or a valid authorized exception exists, including automatic completion paths.

**Given** a valid reasoned coverage exception,
**When** the coverage result is assessed,
**Then** distinguish exception recorded from covered and retain the visible gap,
**And** grant no approval authority or waiver of other finalization conditions.

**Given** required coverage information cannot be verified,
**When** the check fails,
**Then** explain that verification could not finish and offer Retry,
**And** do not claim coverage is complete or a definite gap exists from failed checks.

**Given** cover becomes unavailable after leave is approved,
**When** coverage is reassessed,
**Then** preserve the leave approval and flag Replacement approver needed to authorized
managers without automatic cancellation or extended temporary authority.

**Given** human-selected cover arrangements,
**When** assessment identifies a gap,
**Then** leave selection/appointment to an authorized manager rather than automatically
finding/recommending a substitute,
**And** the applicant needs no appointment permission. Their own responsibility-coverage
condition is distinct from routine availability of the people approving their request.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §10, Leave ADR-0078 with 0077/0079/
0080/0081, spine AD-2/3/7, BIZ-20–22 and FLOW-11–13/20–22. Observe relevant acceptance
failure before authorized implementation; cover no responsibilities, entire/partial
periods, multiple responsibilities, sequential appointments, possible incoming work,
policy-authorized final/temporary-final fallback and remaining gaps, denied authority,
failed verification versus a known gap, valid exception without fictional cover,
automatic finalization blocked and loss of cover preserving approved leave. Connect
actual submission/decision and manager attention consumers before activation; exact
source-to-test paths/commands remain open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind responsibility inventory/temporal scope, authorized
absence/appointment/fallback observations, interval/timezone boundaries and evidence,
exception applicability and freshness, current eligibility and invalidation semantics.
Finalize dependency order so fallback evaluation precedes composed coverage; no future
story dependency may be hidden behind a test fixture. Rule assessment is bounded here;
actual exception recording, request writes, due-work and manager attention integration
must deliver under their owning consumers before affected activation. No new status,
requester duty to arrange cover or automated substitute-search mechanism. Contracts,
final atomic coverage, sizing and readiness remain open.

**Impacts:** Scaffold/shared UI: reuse proven safe assessment/retry and authorized
attention patterns; promote only proven generic gaps at first consumption. Leave owns
coverage/fallback/exception semantics. Agent context: existing instructions suffice.
Documentation: features/EXPERIENCE person-first clarification and epics/tracker/handoff.
ADR: existing accepted decisions unchanged. No application code, tests, migrations,
active grants, provider changes, deployment or implementation authorization.


### Story 5.4: Apply the configured approval fallback during absence

**Scope approved — 2026-10-21, with simplified temporary-final fallback under
[ADR-0146](../../apps/leave/docs/architecture/decisions/0146-temporary-final-approver-follows-configured-absence-policy.md).
Not implementation-ready.** Group 2/10. No extra appointment checkbox/responsibility
for exercising the applicable configured fallback. Accepted predecessors remain unchanged.

As an authorized approver,
I want Leave to apply the organization's configured absence policy,
So that requests can progress with required authority when a usual approver is away.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** the optional absence policy is disabled,
**When** an approver is absent,
**Then** retain all required steps; absence alone does not waive approval.

**Given** the policy is enabled and the supervisor has recorded applicable absence,
**When** the eligible configured final approver acts,
**Then** permit a decision without the supervisor step,
**And** label the omitted step Not required under absence policy rather than Approved.

**Given** the final approver is absent,
**When** the supervisor acts,
**Then** do not allow supervisor-only completion; an authorized temporary final approver
is required.

**Given** both usual approvers are absent and the applicable absence policy is enabled,
**When** an eligible authorized temporary final approver acts,
**Then** permit a decision without the supervisor step under that same policy,
**And** require no extra appointment checkbox or separate fallback responsibility.
Disabled policy still requires both steps. Retain appointment scope/effective dates,
current authority, self-approval restrictions and all other finalization conditions.

**Given** absence is evaluated,
**When** approval action is needed,
**Then** use absence applicable then, not the applicant's future dates or slow response.

**Given** a request waits for the supervisor's return,
**When** they return before a final decision,
**Then** restore their outstanding step under the recorded policy and preserve completed
decisions,
**And** continue normal reminders/escalation while waiting; do not reopen completed
valid final approval. Temporary-assignment return retains its separate authorized rules.

**Given** fallback permits fewer required steps,
**When** finalization is assessed,
**Then** require at least one valid approval and every independent current-authority,
self-approval, funding, document, employment, coverage and employee-response condition.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §10, current approved UX and Leave
ADR-0080/0081 as refined by 0146, 0077–0079/0082; spine AD-2/3/4/7; BIZ-20/21,
FLOW-20–22 and finalization matrix. Failing-first acceptance precedes implementation.
Verify enabled/disabled policy, usual/temporary final actors, both-absent path without
an extra grant flag, denied supervisor-only completion, correct absence date, policy
snapshot/actual actor/omission evidence, no duplicate supervisor substitute for covered
responsibilities, waiting/return/concurrent decision, unchanged completed decisions
and all independent finalization gates. Exact source/test paths/commands remain open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind applicable absence evidence and evaluation time,
policy/appointment versions, omitted-step representation and decision/return concurrency.
Place this rule evaluation before composed Story 5.3 coverage proof in final dependency
consolidation; narrative story numbers are not a claim of finalized implementation
order. Actual request transition persistence and scheduled execution integrate with
owning consumers before activation, with explicit return authorization and no remote
wait under business locks. Routine absence/cover details stay outside requester workflow.
Contracts, final atomic coverage, sizing and readiness remain open.

**Impacts:** Scaffold/shared UI: retain policy-level optional fallback, remove redundant
appointment-option wording from affected review examples; generic controls stay shared,
authority rules stay Leave-owned. Agent context: existing instructions suffice.
Documentation: features, spine, UX/examples, FLOW/coverage story, tracker, handoff and
ADR index synchronized. ADR: new accepted 0146 partially supersedes 0080; predecessors
unchanged. No code, tests, migrations, active grants, deployment or implementation permission.


### Story 5.5: Allow a justified exception when approval coverage is missing

**Delivery split checkpoint — 2026-10-23:** 5.5-A actual exception command/read and fresh-finalization integration approved; 5.5-B existing request/coverage browser approved. Parent remains scope/traceability, not duplicate execution. Real request/kernel prerequisites precede command, with coverage validity enforced at first use. Final contracts/coverage/order/sizing/readiness open.

**Scope approved — 2026-10-21, with authority clarification. Not implementation-
ready.** Group 2/10 scope discussion complete. This exception addresses cover for
the applicant's own approval duties; it neither appoints a temporary reviewer nor
approves the applicant's leave. Leave Manager role alone does not authorize ordinary
request approval: that still needs separate current authority and route assignment.

As an authorized Leave Manager,
I want to permit leave despite an unresolved approval-coverage gap, with a recorded reason,
So that emergencies or other justified circumstances do not prevent appropriate approval.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an identified approval-coverage gap,
**When** an exception is considered,
**Then** require the specific coverage-exception permission,
**And** ordinary approval authority or Organization Administrator status alone is
insufficient. The permission is included in the default Leave Manager role under the
existing catalog decision; custom roles may omit it.

**Given** an authorized exception,
**When** confirmed,
**Then** require a reason and identify the applicant, absence period and uncovered
responsibilities it applies to.

**Given** a valid exception,
**When** final approval is assessed,
**Then** allow that coverage condition to pass while retaining all required decisions,
current authority, funding, employment, documents and employee-response conditions.

**Given** a recorded exception,
**When** authorized managers review coverage,
**Then** retain the visible gap with exception actor/reason,
**And** do not claim a substitute exists or grant anyone approval authority.

**Given** actual absence dates,
**When** coverage is missing,
**Then** preserve those dates rather than shifting them merely to avoid the condition.

**Given** changed absence dates or responsibilities,
**When** exception applicability is reassessed,
**Then** check it against the current situation rather than silently treating it as
an unlimited waiver.

**Given** an authorized manager grants the coverage exception,
**When** the leave request still needs an approval decision,
**Then** retain its normal route; that manager may approve only when separately
currently authorized and assigned. Neither exception authority nor Leave Manager
status alone substitutes for the required approval or appoints someone to decide.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §10/Permissions; Leave ADR-0078,
0079/0082, spine AD-2/3/4/7; FLOW-11/12/25 and finalization matrix. Failing-first
acceptance precedes implementation. Verify scoped authorized/denied exception, default
versus custom-role capability, mandatory reason, applicant/period/responsibility bounds,
visible gap versus real coverage, true absence dates, changed-context applicability,
all automatic/manual finalization gates and separate route/decision authority. Example:
a supervisor unexpectedly becomes ill without team cover; an authorized exception
removes that coverage blocker but their own leave still needs normal route approval.
Exact test paths/commands and actual request-consumer evidence remain open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Define exception validity/evidence, current capability
checks, applicable changes and review/reconfirmation, revisions/operation identity,
request/absence scope and minimal audit. Rule validity belongs here; actual recording
and confirmation must integrate atomically with the owning real request consumer before
activation, with no extra approval tier or partial standalone administrative draft UI.
Do not claim a future request-write dependency is implemented by a fixture. Final
implementation dependency order, atomic coverage, contracts, sizing/readiness remain open.

**Impacts:** Scaffold/shared UI: reuse proven scoped review/reason, attribution,
revision/retry and attention patterns; Leave owns exception applicability. Promote
only proven domain-neutral gaps at first consumer. Agent context: existing rules
suffice. Documentation: epics/tracker/handoff record clarified authority; existing
features/UX and ADR-0078/0082 already state these boundaries. ADR: no new decision or
change to accepted files. No code, tests, migration, grants, deployment or implementation.


### Story 5.6: Validate requested duration and same-date limits

**Scope approved — 2026-10-21, with mixed-range and duration-limit clarifications.
Not implementation-ready.** Group 3/10. The daily limit is combined active leave
minutes on an absence date, never a limit on how many requests are submitted in a day.

As an employee requesting leave,
I want Leave to validate duration against my schedule and existing requests,
So that the request records the correct amount without exceeding a working day.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a selected leave type,
**When** request duration is validated,
**Then** accept only its permitted full-day, half-day or hourly modes.

**Given** a valid range containing working and non-working dates,
**When** duration is calculated,
**Then** accept the whole selected range and use E3's authoritative effective schedule/
calendar calculation to count working time only, explaining excluded non-working dates,
**And** never require the employee to split a range around weekends/holidays or remove
non-working dates. Friday through Monday is valid when it includes eligible working
time. Block invalid ranges or ranges with no eligible working time at all, not merely
because some dates are non-working. Other eligibility rules remain independent.

**Given** half-day leave,
**When** duration is validated,
**Then** use exactly half that date's scheduled working time: a 450-minute day gives
225 minutes, without rounding to a 30-minute input increment.

**Given** hourly leave,
**When** input is validated,
**Then** require one date and a positive duration in 30-minute increments without exact
start/end times.

**Given** another active request for the same employee, organization and absence date,
**When** checking the new request,
**Then** warn and total durations across leave types, counting submitted, in-approval
and approved requests and excluding drafts, rejected, withdrawn and cancelled requests.

**Given** combined active durations within that date's scheduled working time,
**When** validation runs,
**Then** permit them subject to all other rules and block totals exceeding scheduled
working time. Two two-hour requests fit an eight-hour day; a full day plus another
hour does not. This is not a submission-count limit or a fixed eight-hour assumption.

**Given** simultaneous requests covering the same absence date,
**When** they are submitted,
**Then** ensure their combined active leave duration does not exceed that date's
scheduled working time, with atomic enforcement against concurrent submissions.

**Given** failed validation or unavailable required schedule information,
**When** the result is reported,
**Then** preserve entered input and explain the problem,
**And** failed verification must not imply valid duration or no conflicting requests.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §6/7/8, Leave ADR-0003/0074, spine
AD-3/4/6/7/8, BIZ-15/23, CALC-26/28 and E3 duration/restriction scopes. Failing-first
acceptance precedes implementation. Verify permitted modes, full range with non-working
dates, zero-time/invalid range, historical/nonstandard schedule, 450/225 half-day example,
hour increments versus entitlement-minute precision, same-date state inclusion/exclusion
across types, within/exceeded duration, concurrent capacity race and safe unavailable
inputs. No request-count cap or exact-time clash logic. Exact test paths/commands pending.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Consume real E3 calculation/restriction contracts and
bind active-state/date aggregation, current authority, schedules/calendar versions,
safe typed errors and protected validation-to-commit coordination. The rule/check scope
belongs here; owning submission/resubmission consumers must implement and prove actual
atomic aggregate enforcement before activation. Earlier preview fixtures do not prove
those writes. Preserve E1 lightweight draft input, including incomplete/invalid values;
submission validity is not a prerequisite merely to save. Other employment/policy,
funding, document and finalization guards remain independent. Contracts, final atomic
coverage, dependency ordering, agent sizing/readiness remain open.

**Impacts:** Scaffold/shared UI: reuse proven date/range/duration and safe feedback
patterns, promote only proven generic gaps at first consumer; Leave owns duration/state
aggregation rules. Agent context: existing rules suffice. Documentation: epics/tracker/
handoff preserve user clarifications and source/test mapping; existing feature/UX rules
already permit mixed ranges and define duration-only partial days. ADR: accepted rules
unchanged, no new decision needed. No code, tests, migration, grants, deployment or
implementation authorization.


### Story 5.7: Check employment, policy eligibility and permitted request dates

**Scope approved — 2026-10-21. Not implementation-ready.** Group 3/10. Consume
E3's existing typed guidance as consequential validation; preserve E1 lightweight
input saving and historical policy/assignment meaning.

As an employee requesting leave,
I want Leave to explain and enforce applicable employment and date rules,
So that I can submit an eligible request without losing unfinished input.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** the employee, leave type and requested dates,
**When** eligibility is checked,
**Then** use applicable explicit policy assignment and effective employment information,
**And** do not infer eligibility from department, location or a matching filter.

**Given** a known employment end date,
**When** checking submission or final approval,
**Then** block requested dates after it and retain the final employment date as eligible
under normal rules,
**And** do not silently trim the request.

**Given** the policy's advance-booking window,
**When** submitting,
**Then** require every requested date to fit, including the last date and inclusive
cutoff. Default is twelve months; an acceptable start does not excuse an out-of-window end.

**Given** less than configured minimum notice,
**When** submitting,
**Then** require an explanation and flag short notice for the approver rather than
prohibiting the request solely for short notice. Default zero-day notice requires no
explanation for otherwise eligible same-day leave.

**Given** backdated leave,
**When** submitting,
**Then** require a reason, show the approver lateness and apply historical schedule/
policy rules,
**And** impose no fixed backdating cutoff or special administrative route solely
because the request is late.

**Given** changed employment or applicable configuration since preview,
**When** confirming a consequential action,
**Then** recheck relevant inputs and explain materially changed reviewed outcomes,
requiring renewed confirmation,
**And** do not silently replace the request's snapshotted policy.

**Given** missing configuration or failed dependency verification,
**When** reporting the result,
**Then** distinguish definite eligibility problems from Couldn't check / Retry,
**And** preserve input and ordinary draft saving. Saved draft does not promise eligibility.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §4/6/7/10, Leave ADR-0035/0036,
0049/0050/0051/0112/0126, spine AD-2/3/4/5/7/8, E3 Story 3.20, applicable BIZ-13/16
and CALC-22/26/29. Failing-first acceptance precedes implementation. Verify explicit
assignment versus filter inference, historical applicability, inclusive employment end,
full-range booking cutoff and deterministic month/leap arithmetic, zero/positive notice,
required short-notice/backdated reasons and lateness, no age-only cutoff, materially
changed versus unchanged reviewed outcomes, preserved snapshots/input and missing versus
unavailable observations. Bind combined-reason semantics without inventing extra user
work. Exact test paths/commands/source-to-test mapping remain open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind effective employment/assignment/version contracts,
work-timezone date arithmetic, notice/booking cutoff, rule-result schema, safe errors
and consequential observation/coordination freshness. Existing request-impact writes
must coordinate their effects before activation; actual submission/final-approval
consumers integrate these guards and prove no relevant change slips between validation
and commit. No remote waits under business locks by default. Funding/documents/route
and other independent finalization checks remain separate. Final contracts, source/test
coverage, dependency ordering, sizing and readiness remain open.

**Impacts:** Scaffold/shared UI: reuse proven typed guidance, field/review/reconfirmation
and retry controls, promoting only proven generic gaps; Leave owns rule applicability.
Agent context: existing instructions suffice. Documentation: epics/tracker/handoff;
existing features/UX/ADRs already define these rules. ADR: accepted predecessors unchanged,
no new decision needed. No code, tests, migrations, grants, deployment or implementation.


### Story 5.8: Validate funding without taking entitlement reserved for another request

**Commitment extraction approved — 2026-10-23:** This original funding-validation scope
continues to reuse E3's projection and allocation rules. New approved 5.8-A owns shared
actual request commitment writes and first guard adoption; actual producers keep their
own policy/authority/gate/effect integration. No duplicate calculator/ledger or silent
approval of unrelated reallocation behavior. Final contracts/size/readiness remain open.

**Scope approved — 2026-10-21, unchanged after shortfall-context explanation. Not
implementation-ready.** Group 3/10. User requested no rewording. Shortfall discussion
explained an ordinary unfunded request portion versus approved unpaid leave or an
actual negative paid balance; it did not approve a borrowing/repayment mechanism or
resolve its remaining contracts. Preserve the accepted scope below.

As an employee requesting leave,
I want Leave to check funding for my requested dates and explain any shortfall,
So that I understand the paid/unpaid consequences before submitting.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a balance-tracked policy,
**When** funding is checked,
**Then** use E3's authoritative date-by-date calculation and count only entitlement
valid and available on each leave date, including eligible projected earning/carry-over.

**Given** earning becomes available between requested dates,
**When** allocating funding,
**Then** it may fund later dates but cannot cover an earlier shortfall,
**And** the same entitlement cannot fund multiple dates twice.

**Given** existing reservations,
**When** checking a new request,
**Then** protect them and use only remaining eligible entitlement, even when the new
request's leave dates are earlier.

**Given** several eligible entitlement portions,
**When** allocating,
**Then** use earliest expiry first, resolving equal expiry by oldest original source
period then stable portion identity,
**And** do not silently borrow from another leave type.

**Given** insufficient funding,
**When** presenting the result,
**Then** show exact funded and requested-unpaid amounts and permit progression only
under the applicable policy's override/unpaid rules,
**And** a calculated shortfall is neither an authorized override nor approved unpaid leave.

**Given** a policy with No balance tracking,
**When** validating,
**Then** show Not balance-limited, retain configured paid/unpaid classification and
all other request checks,
**And** create no fictional balance, entitlement reservation or shortfall.

**Given** changed funding inputs or simultaneous competing requests,
**When** confirming submission,
**Then** revalidate and protect allocation through commit,
**And** materially changed consequences require refreshed review and any required exact
unpaid acknowledgement.

**Given** funding cannot be verified,
**When** the check fails,
**Then** offer Retry and preserve input,
**And** do not interpret failure as zero entitlement, sufficient funding or no balance tracking.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §6/7/9, Leave ADR-0019/0020/0031/
0032/0035/0112/0128/0129/0135, spine AD-3–7; BIZ-10–12/16/18/23 and applicable CALC
allocation/reservation examples, E3 Story 3.18. Failing-first acceptance precedes code.
Verify date-by-date funding, earning between dates without retrospective repair, no
portion double-use, earlier-date new request not displacing prior reservation, expiry/
source-period/stable identity priority, permitted shortfall versus unauthorized funding,
tracked/manual-only/untracked distinction, independent paid/unpaid classification,
concurrent competing allocation, changed-input review/acknowledgement and safe unavailable
results. Exact source/test paths/commands and actual request-consumer evidence remain open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Consume authoritative E3 allocation and actual active
reservation inputs. Bind stable portions/provenance, projected versus earned amounts,
permitted policy shortfall/override result types, typed not-applicable, reviewed input
versions and protected validation-to-commit coordination across related writers.
Reservation writes, authorized override decisions and employee responses belong to
owning request workflows and require actual integration before activation. Do not
invent negative-paid borrowing/repayment defaults from generic catalogue wording;
resolve applicable exception rules before their affected consumer is ready. Existing
correction/deficit review remains distinct. Contracts, final atomic coverage, dependency
order, sizing and readiness remain open.

**Impacts:** Scaffold/shared UI: reuse proven allocation/explanation, typed applicability,
review/retry patterns; promote only proven generic gaps with first use. Leave owns funding
semantics. Agent context: existing rules suffice. Documentation: epics/tracker/handoff
record approval without changing the agreed story or authoritative business rules.
ADR: accepted decisions unchanged; no new rule approved by the shortfall explanation.
No code, tests, migration, active grants, deployment or implementation authorization.


### Story 5.9: Check required supporting documents before submission and final approval

**Scope approved — 2026-10-21, retaining separate medical-document permission without
default Approver/Leave Manager grants. Not implementation-ready.** Group 3/10. The
alternative of default/bundled document rights was discussed and withdrawn; do not
implement it. Temporary appointment grants no separate document permission.

As an employee submitting leave,
I want Leave to explain and check applicable document requirements,
So that I can provide what is needed and submit confidently.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** the applicable policy and calculated duration,
**When** document requirements are checked,
**Then** apply the configured requirement and threshold precisely. Required above two
days does not require a document at exactly two days.

**Given** a required document,
**When** submission is validated,
**Then** require a confirmed request/draft association to E4-verified ready content,
**And** upload success alone does not satisfy the requirement.

**Given** a missing, pending, rejected or failed required attachment,
**When** submission is attempted,
**Then** explain what needs attention, preserve request input and do not submit while
the requirement remains unmet.

**Given** document status cannot be checked,
**When** verification fails,
**Then** offer Retry without claiming missing/ready status and retain ordinary draft
saving availability.

**Given** final approval is attempted,
**When** required document readiness is checked,
**Then** verify the applicable requirement still passes; a stale preview or completed
approval step cannot bypass it.

**Given** an assigned approver or Leave Manager without sensitive-document permission,
**When** reviewing the request,
**Then** expose only safe provision/verification status in API/UI, not filenames,
previews or bytes. Existing scoped leave-type/note/history visibility is unchanged.
Medical-document permission is separately granted, not part of either role by default.

**Given** valid evidence already attached,
**When** the request progresses,
**Then** preserve verified content identity and association protection without requiring
a fresh upload merely because submission or approval occurs.

**Document-review clarification:** Approval does not require a human to inspect the
medical document. Technical verification/readiness is not medical/factual validation.
Authorized document readers may inspect retained evidence through permitted history
later; current permission/resource checks and retention still apply. Historical
involvement alone gives no retained access. Investigation does not automatically reverse
approval/balances; resulting corrections require their own authorized action. No new
human verification role/gate or default permission is introduced.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §4/7/12 and permission-default
clarification, Leave ADR-0006/0016/0017, platform ADR-0030/0038/0054/0055, spine AD-2/7/9;
BIZ-16/27/28, PRIV-04 and actual E4 integration obligations. Failing-first acceptance
precedes code. Verify precise duration threshold, actual confirmed association/verified
bytes, pending/rejected/missing versus unavailable status, input preservation, no forced
reupload, required status at finalization, scoped metadata/status projections for employee/
approver/manager/temporary actors, no default document permission, authorized retained
history versus revoked access/retention and no mandatory human document-read gate.
Exact test paths/commands and actual submission/decision integration remain open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind policy-version/threshold conversion and E4 association/
content-identity/readiness observation contracts, confirmation/cleanup/disposal coordination,
current access and safe typed status. Preserve fixed verified bytes and protected request
references through draft closure/submission; a browser upload result is not evidence.
Keep external service waits outside business locks by default and prove no race defeats
required-document checks. Actual consequential consumers must integrate before activation;
E4 fixture proof alone is insufficient. No new upload UI, document-review role, mandatory
malware scan or separate content authorization service. Contracts, final source/test
coverage, dependency order, sizing and readiness remain open.

**Impacts:** Scaffold/shared UI: consume E4 proven Content clients/status/privacy controls,
promote only a proven generic gap in first use; Leave owns document requirements and
request authorization. Agent context: existing instructions suffice. Documentation:
features and epics/tracker/handoff record retained permission defaults and actual consumer
obligations; existing E4/UX protected-document rules remain binding. ADR: original accepted
boundaries retained, no superseding document-access decision. No code, tests, migration,
permission grants, provider changes, deployment or implementation authorization.


### Story 5.10: Finalize approval only when every required condition passes

**Core extraction approved — 2026-10-23:** 5.10-A owns persisted existing-request/current-read/outcome support; approved 5.10-B owns protected finalization before actual consequential source writers and submission. Common work is extracted from 5.11-A once; original rule scope remains traceability and actual producer integrations remain required. No concrete consistency protocol, final order, size or readiness PASS inferred.

**Completion-trigger refinement — accepted 2026-10-22, L-0154:** Resolving an
outstanding condition after required decisions are recorded triggers fresh finalization
without repeated approval/manual completion. Includes valid required cover and initial
unpaid on-behalf response. Reads never trigger approval. All current gates and actual
decision attribution remain; exact command/scheduled/recovery owner mapping is open.
Affected coverage/response consumers and 5.32 must prove real integration.

**Scope approved — 2026-10-21. Not implementation-ready.** Group 3/10 scope discussion
complete. This composes independent domain guards, not a new approval tier or generic
workflow engine. Exact completion triggers/atomic integration remain explicit gates.

As an employee and authorized approver,
I want final approval to check all required conditions together,
So that an approval decision cannot accidentally bypass another safeguard.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a request approaching completion,
**When** finalization is assessed,
**Then** require every currently required approval decision accounting for valid configured
absence fallback,
**And** require at least one valid approval.

**Given** required decisions are satisfied,
**When** finalizing,
**Then** independently check current authority, employment/date eligibility, valid duration/
funding, required documents, applicant responsibility coverage or valid exception and
any required employee unpaid acknowledgement.

**Given** one condition remains unmet,
**When** other approval steps are completed,
**Then** preserve valid decisions, keep the overall request pending with a clear explanation
and retain applicable reservations without consuming entitlement yet.

**Given** an authorized submitting approver already satisfied their own step,
**When** remaining conditions later pass,
**Then** do not require repeat approval, including a sole on-behalf approver waiting for
the employee's unpaid response.

**Given** an employee response to an unpaid amount,
**When** acknowledgement is checked,
**Then** require it to satisfy the current amount under existing rules,
**And** do not substitute it for approval, valid funding, coverage or another unmet condition.

**Given** all conditions pass,
**When** finalization commits,
**Then** mark the request Approved and convert applicable reservations to consumption
exactly once with required history, audit and notification intent,
**And** untracked policies record approval/usage without fictional entitlement effects.

**Given** competing approvals, employee responses, withdrawal or relevant configuration
changes,
**When** they race or retry,
**Then** prevent duplicate consumption, stale finalization or resurrection of a closed
request, rechecking materially changed reviewed consequences before proceeding.

**Given** a required check cannot finish,
**When** finalization is attempted,
**Then** retain a truthful pending outcome and offer appropriate recovery,
**And** do not report approval success or silently waive the check.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §7/9–11, state/reservation models;
Leave ADR-0007/0008/0032/0049/0078/0088/0112/0113/0128/0135/0146; spine AD-2–8/10/11;
FLOW-05/06/08–13/20–25 and finalization matrix. Failing-first acceptance precedes
implementation. Verify each independent gate alone blocked/satisfied, authorized
omission with at least one decision, later-step acceptance then earlier decision,
sole on-behalf step waiting for exact employee response, valid decisions retained,
no-repeat approval, tracked/untracked effects, competing finalizers/acknowledgements/
withdrawal/configuration writers, changed-review recovery, atomic audit/outbox/outcome
and safe unavailable checks. Actual owning request consumers must prove integration;
exact test paths/commands remain open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind current-input consistency and protected commit,
request/cycle/step revisions, operation/outcome identities, calculation/coverage/document/
acknowledgement evidence and atomic effect envelope. Enumerate exact finalization entry
points before affected readiness, including resolution of a coverage gate after decisions
already exist; do not infer unspecified background auto-approval or a new waiting status.
Place actual prerequisites before each consumer in final dependency consolidation;
rule fixtures do not establish request mutation/worker implementation. Preserve short
transactions and all alternate relevant writer participation. Contracts, final atomic
coverage, implementation order, agent sizing/readiness remain open.

**Impacts:** Scaffold/shared UI: use proven operation/revision/coordination, explanation,
retry and outcome controls, promote proven generic gaps with the consuming story; Leave
owns finalization composition. Agent context: existing rules suffice. Documentation:
epics/tracker/handoff preserve approval and exact-trigger gates. ADR: existing accepted
rules retained, no new decision. No code, tests, migrations, grants, deployment or
implementation authorization.


### Story 5.11: Submit my own leave request and receive a clear result

**Delivery split checkpoint — 2026-10-22:** 5.11-A and 5.11-B boundaries are approved
and appended below with AC ownership. Original scope remains the traceability parent.
Retain this original as scope/traceability, not another implementation item alongside
its replacement slices. No original AC is removed; final sizing/order remain open.

**Scope approved — 2026-10-21, with routing/activity and Retry simplifications under
P-0060/L-0147/0148. Not implementation-ready.** Group 4/10. Record the ordinary required
steps/policy and local request state, not a database backup/snapshot engine. Effective
supervisor changes follow the eligible replacement for unfinished supervisor steps;
change activity and actual actor/acting-for decisions explain history without duplicate
reassignment logs. Keep independent policy/calculation evidence and required local audit.

As an employee,
I want to submit my reviewed leave request and know whether it succeeded,
So that I can finish applying without duplicate requests or uncertainty.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** my application is ready for review,
**When** I reach submission,
**Then** show concise leave type, dates, duration and paid/requested-unpaid split,
with organization in the header and blockers beside relevant fields.

**Given** requested unpaid leave,
**When** submitting,
**Then** require acknowledgement of the exact amount. Without unpaid leave, one Submit
request action suffices, with no additional confirmation screen.

**Given** I submit,
**When** Leave processes the action,
**Then** recheck current access, draft revision and applicable submission rules with
authoritative inputs and record required approval steps/eligible assignments and policy,
**And** do not rely on earlier preview. Apply P-0060/L-0147 subsequent supervisor routing
and history rules, not a permanent freeze of unfinished supervisor assignees.

**Given** valid submission,
**When** it commits,
**Then** create one permanent request/approval cycle, reserve applicable entitlement,
close the draft and record required evidence/audit/operation outcome/notification intent
atomically, preserving document associations,
**And** create no fictional entitlement effects for untracked policies.

**Given** I am an authorized assigned approver and self-approval is explicitly enabled,
**When** submitting,
**Then** record only my own permitted automatic decision and immediately approve the
request only if all required decisions and independent finalization conditions pass;
otherwise retain pending state.

**Given** confirmed success,
**When** its result arrives,
**Then** close the form and return to My Leave with list context preserved, brief Request
submitted, optional View request and authoritative list status; remove the submitted-
draft indicator and do not automatically open another details screen.

**Given** confirmed failure or uncertain outcome,
**When** presenting recovery,
**Then** preserve input and offer appropriate Retry/correction. Retry first resolves the
original operation, returning existing success or safely retrying the same submission
only when established safe. If still unknown, retain the form and explain confirmation
could not finish; no new submission and no separate Check status action (L-0148).

**Given** duplicate clicks, response loss or late autosaves from another tab,
**When** they arrive,
**Then** create no duplicate request/reservation and never reopen/overwrite the closed draft.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §7/9–11/state models, accepted Apply/
My Leave UX; P-0012/0013/0020/0022/0025/0030/0033/0034/0060 and L-0007/0008/0069/0071/
0075/0087/0112/0118/0123/0135/0147/0148; BIZ-14–16/19/23/29–31, FLOW-01–08/25/28,
PRIV-04/05/10/21/22, E1 draft/E3 calculation and delivery/E4 integration obligations.
Observe failing acceptance before implementation. Prove own summary/exact acknowledgement,
material revalidation/reconfirmation, real guards/route/current supervisor authority,
automatic own-step eligibility, pending/approved outcomes, atomic draft/request/reservation/
content protection/audit/outbox/outcome, closed-draft race, duplicate/lost-response/unknown
recovery, authoritative list versus failed refresh and desktop/mobile/focus/accessibility.
Required notifications use real E3 delivery/privacy; owner/configuration writers integrate
actual request impacts before activation. Exact test paths/commands/source mapping open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind payload/revision versus pending autosave handling,
operation outcome/retention and same-payload retry, fresh shared observations/consistency,
step/policy evidence and P-0060 transfer propagation bounds, actual dependency guards,
allocation/ledger and document association across draft closure, notification envelope/
recipients and honest UI transitions. No remote waits under business locks by default.
All prerequisites must work before this consumer; later group-10 proof cannot defer
correctness. On-behalf submission is separate. Final decomposition/agent sizing, atomic
coverage, exact contracts and readiness remain open; no implementation permission.

**Impacts:** Scaffold/shared UI: prove/publish required generic summary/recovery/revision/
outcome/closed-draft patterns with first actual consumer; Leave owns request effects and
return destination. Reuse existing activity/audit, not parallel reassignment history.

Later same-cycle unpaid changes notify without reopening; new cycles apply initial rules. Actual allocation/response writer integration and race evidence remain required.

As an authorized Leave Manager or approver with scoped on-behalf submission access,
I want to submit a request for a selected employee with clear attribution/consequences,
So that I can record leave when they need assistance.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** current scoped on-behalf submission permission,
**When** starting,
**Then** permit employee selection within that scope and clearly identify employee and
recording actor. Standard Approver includes this capability by default; custom approval-
only or temporary-only authority cannot substitute for the grant (L-0149).

**Given** a selected employee,
**When** entering leave,
**Then** use that employee's applicable policy/schedule/funding, not the manager's,
**And** require a reason for acting on their behalf.

**Given** completed input,
**When** reviewing,
**Then** show employee, dates, duration, allocation, reason and actual approval consequence
before Submit for employee.

**Given** submission,
**When** processed,
**Then** apply ordinary current-access, eligibility, duration, funding, document and routing
checks and commit required request/reservation/audit/outcome/notification effects together,
**And** record employee separately from actor.

**Given** the submitter also owns an authorized approval step,
**When** submitting,
**Then** record only their own permitted decision even if it is a later step,
**And** do not satisfy another person's step or require repeat of a valid decision later.

**Given** requested unpaid leave,
**When** the authorized actor submits,
**Then** allow submission with reason/allocation but require the employee's own exact-
amount response before final approval,
**And** the submitting actor cannot acknowledge for the employee.

**Given** all decisions are satisfied but employee response or another finalization
condition is missing,
**When** submission completes,
**Then** retain pending state and applicable reservations, finalizing once only after
all conditions pass.

**Given** the employee already has a saved draft,
**When** on-behalf submission occurs,
**Then** leave it untouched, notify the employee and show Your response is needed on
My Leave where a response is required.

**Given** failure, unknown outcome or repeated submission,
**When** recovery runs,
**Then** preserve entered information and resolve/retry the original operation safely
without duplicate requests or entitlement effects (L-0148).

### Story 5.13: Review and authorize an exceptional funding allocation

**Delivery split — 2026-10-22:** Protected review/proposal/funding-only/combined API
boundary 5.13-A is approved/appended. Corresponding browser boundary 5.13-B is now
approved/appended. Reuse completed ordinary decisions; preserve this parent as scope/traceability,
not duplicate implementation. Later pending-change notices retain L-0151, not renewed response.

**Scope approved — 2026-10-21, with simplified authority and combined confirmation
under L-0150. Not implementation-ready.** Group 5/10. One scoped exceptional-funding
capability covers permitted request-specific sources; no additional per-line grants.
Funding and approval outcomes are distinct records/effects, not extra user workflow.

As an actor authorized to decide balance overrides,
I want to review a shortfall and choose a permitted funding allocation with a reason,
So that exceptional leave can be handled without rewriting ordinary recurring entitlement.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a request needing a balance override,
**When** review opens,
**Then** show requested duration, eligible available/projected funding, protected
reservations and shortfall, with unpaid as the default proposal rather than approved outcome.

**Given** an actor reviewing alternatives,
**When** an allocation is confirmed,
**Then** require one current scoped exceptional-funding capability and an exception reason,
**And** validate permitted source type/employee/organization/date/amount/expiry/reservations
as business rules, not per-source permission grants. Ordinary approval/on-behalf
permission alone does not grant funding authority or unrelated standalone adjustment powers.

**Given** permitted alternatives,
**When** allocating,
**Then** support explicit source/duration lines for eligible balances, permitted request-
specific discretionary paid grants and unpaid leave, linking authorizer/exception reason,
**And** never silently borrow another type or change recurring entitlement.

**Given** proposed allocation,
**When** reviewed,
**Then** account for the entire requested duration without double funding, preserve date
validity/expiry/reservations and show the resulting paid/requested-unpaid split.

**Given** funding-only confirmation or an actor authorized for both funding and their
required approval step,
**When** confirming,
**Then** allow funding-only confirmation or one Approve with exception action respectively,
**And** record allocation/sources/actor/reason and any actual approval-step outcome distinctly
through existing records/activity/audit. Commit the combined action/effects/outcome/intent
atomically; a stale/unauthorized combined action does not partly execute. A reason alone
is not a funding record, and funding-only confirmation satisfies no approval step.

**Given** an increased requested-unpaid amount,
**When** confirmed,
**Then** show prior/revised amounts/explanation and notify the employee without a renewed
acknowledgement gate (L-0151). Preserve any outstanding required initial on-behalf response,
valid decisions and all other finalization gates.

**Given** changed inputs, conflicting actions or unknown results,
**When** confirmation/retry runs,
**Then** revalidate/recover the original operation without duplicate grants/reservations/
decisions, preserving entered allocation/reason where authorized.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §6/9/10, L-0032/0088/0112/0128/0150,
spine AD-2–7/10/11, BIZ-18, CALC-25, E3 Story 3.21 and allocation-review UX. Failing-first
acceptance precedes code. Verify single exception capability over mixed permitted
sources, denied scope/invalid source, no unrelated adjustment power, request-specific

### Story 5.14: Respond to the exact requested unpaid amount

**Zero-unpaid refinement accepted — 2026-10-23, L-0162:** An authorized change to zero closes the outstanding initial on-behalf response without employee acknowledgement; preserve history and reassess all gates. Later same-cycle unpaid changes notify without reopening; new cycles apply initial rules. Actual allocation/response writer integration and race evidence remain required.

**Delivery consolidation — 2026-10-22:** Protected on-behalf submission and initial
employee-response API portions are combined in approved 5.12-A, appended below.
Corresponding 5.12-B browser boundary is now approved and appended. Keep this parent for source
traceability, not duplicate implementation. Later pending-change producer/display
integration remains with 5.13/5.15 under L-0151; exact residual/test allocation is open.

**Scope refinement — 2026-10-21, L-0151:** Retain the initial unpaid on-behalf response,
not renewed acknowledgement for later pending changes. Once an initial response is
satisfied, later increases/decreases notify only. If it remains outstanding, apply its
current-amount checks; do not create it solely because an originally fully-paid pending
request later changes. Earlier broader response test obligations are superseded below.

**Scope approved — 2026-10-21. Not implementation-ready.** Group 5/10. Response stays
in the existing submitted request; it is employee acknowledgement, not approval or
funding authority. Initial own-request acknowledgement remains part of submission.

As an employee,
I want to see and acknowledge the current unpaid amount of an initial unpaid request
submitted on my behalf,
So that final approval cannot occur without my informed response where required.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an on-behalf request containing unpaid leave,
**When** submitted,
**Then** notify the employee and show Your response is needed on My Leave, opening
that request with exact requested-unpaid amount and paid/unpaid breakdown.

**Given** a later authorized change increases or decreases pending unpaid allocation,
**When** presenting the updated request,
**Then** show prior/revised amounts, actor/reason and notify without a renewed response
gate. An outstanding required initial unpaid on-behalf response remains independently
applicable to current amount/evidence (L-0151).

**Given** a required response,
**When** acknowledgement is attempted,
**Then** accept only the employee's own response under current access,
**And** an approver or on-behalf actor cannot respond for them.

**Given** allocation changes while the response is open,
**When** the employee confirms,
**Then** check the current amount rather than accept a stale response,
**And** this current-amount check applies to an outstanding initial unpaid on-behalf
response, not a renewed response after later allocation changes (L-0151).

**Given** successful acknowledgement,
**When** all remaining finalization conditions pass,
**Then** finalize once without repeating valid approvals,
**And** retain pending state/reservations if another condition remains unmet.

**Given** a notification is opened/marked read,
**When** its read state changes,
**Then** do not count it as acknowledgement; retain the business response until resolved.

**Given** a request eligible for withdrawal,
**When** the employee chooses withdrawal instead,
**Then** retain that ordinary option; a response prompt does not force acknowledgement.

**Given** failed/unknown/duplicate response or a request closed elsewhere,
**When** responding or retrying,
**Then** recover safely without duplicate finalization or reopening the request,
**And** leave any separate employee draft untouched.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §6/7/9–11/13/14; L-0032/0069/0088/
0112/0128/0148/0150; spine AD-2–8/10/11, BIZ-12/17/18/23/31, FLOW-08–10/25 and
PRIV-05/08/10/13/22. Failing-first acceptance precedes code. Verify initial on-behalf
handoff with sole/later/non-approver submitter, exact current response and denied proxy,
explained increased amount, stale response, unchanged/decreased valid acknowledgement,
initial versus renewed response, notification-read independence, withdrawal availability,
unchanged draft, pending other gates and one-time finalization. Pair actual request/
API/database/browser/current-access and notification assertions; exact tests/commands open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind response operation/current-request/allocation revisions,
acknowledged-amount evidence and applicability, current actor/employee linking and
unavailable/inactive access, notification/required-action state, withdrawal/closure races
and original-operation retry. Apply stronger consequential checks, not E1 draft observation
allowances. Actual employee-response finalization and competing approval/configuration
writers must integrate atomically before activation; earlier fixtures do not prove them.
Exact commands/triggers for other finalization entry points remain owning gates.
Contracts, final source/test coverage, dependency order, sizing/readiness remain open.

**Impacts:** Scaffold/shared UI: reuse proven in-request summary/reason/response, required-
action/read-state separation, safe retry and outcome controls, promoting only proven
generic gaps. Leave owns response validity and finalization. Agent context: existing
rules suffice. Documentation: epics/tracker/handoff; authoritative features/UX already
carry this flow. ADR: existing rules retained, no new decision. No separate workspace,
new approval role, code, tests, migration, grants, deployment or implementation permission.

As an authorized administrator changing employment, policy or balance information,
I want to review consequences for pending leave requests,
So that changes do not silently alter employees' leave arrangements.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a proposed change affects pending requests,
**When** reviewing it,
**Then** identify affected requests and before/after funding or eligibility consequences
before confirmation.

**Given** consequential request changes,
**When** confirming,
**Then** require appropriate authority and an employee-visible explanation,
**And** record actor/reason/actual effects through existing activity/audit.

**Given** a later authorized pending paid/unpaid allocation change,
**When** applying it,
**Then** show previous/revised amounts and actor/reason, and notify the employee with a
link to authorized details, without renewed acknowledgement or a new response blocker,
**And** preserve an independently outstanding initial unpaid on-behalf response under
L-0088/0151. Prior necessary discussion is the author's organizational responsibility,
not another system checkbox/workflow or proof of consent from a notification.

**Given** an affected pending request,
**When** the change takes effect,
**Then** preserve valid decisions/history, without automatic rejection/cancellation/date
trimming,
**And** expose unresolved consequences through authorized details and manager attention.

**Given** another eligibility condition becomes invalid, such as dates beyond corrected
employment end,
**When** final approval is evaluated,
**Then** retain that blocker independently of allocation notification or any initial response.

**Given** resolution needs exceptional funding, adjustment or correction,
**When** attempted,
**Then** require its corresponding current scoped authority under the applicable action
rules, including L-0150 request exception scope,
**And** use existing actions/human coordination without a referral workflow or temporary
permission-transfer mechanism.

**Given** concurrent changes/decisions/retries,
**When** applying consequences,
**Then** protect reviewed inputs, reservations and request revisions without duplicate
effects or lost impact evidence,
**And** unavailable checks do not mean no affected requests.

**Given** ordinary expected accrual, expiry or rollover,
**When** time passes,
**Then** use original projection consequences; routine time passage alone does not
unexpectedly increase unpaid leave.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §6/7/9–11/17, L-0032/0049/0112/0128/
0150/0151, spine AD-2–8/10/11, BIZ-11–13/18/23/32, CALC-24, FLOW-10/25 and E2/E3
actual writer-consumer obligations. Failing-first acceptance precedes implementation.
Verify reviewed affected set/before-after, authorized source mutation and remedies,
mandatory explanation, increased/decreased unpaid notification without renewal gate,
outstanding versus satisfied initial response, preserved decisions/pending dates,
independent employment/funding/document/coverage blockers, authorized attention scope,
ordinary rollover projection and actual writer/request races/retry/missing observations.
Pair real owner/API/database/browser/notification proof; exact paths/commands open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Inventory affected E2/E3 writer families, impacted-request
query/evidence/revision contracts and exact local versus shared-owner consequence timing,
review freshness/current authority, atomic local effect/audit/outcome/notification and
truthful pending/partial/recovery results. No remote waits under business locks by default.
No change to approved-request history/resolution safeguards: discretionary approved
impacts resolve before commit and necessary factual correction retains its existing

paths rather than activating unsafe writers. Final contracts, atomic source/test coverage,

consumer. Leave owns impacts/authority; shared owners retain their facts/contracts.

As an authorized approver,
I want one clear queue of requests currently requiring my decision,
So that I can understand and prioritize my approval work.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** current approval responsibilities,
**When** opening Approvals,
**Then** list authorized requests whose steps currently need that actor's decision,
excluding completed decisions and later steps not yet actionable.

**Given** ordinary or temporary assignments,
**When** listing work,
**Then** use the same queue, with Acting for [person] · until [date] for temporary
work rather than a separate delegated-work section.

**Given** effective supervisor change or expired/lost authority,
**When** loading/refreshing,
**Then** reflect current responsibility under P-0060/L-0147 and temporary authority rules,
**And** earlier notifications/cached rows grant no access.

**Given** a queue row,
**When** displayed,
**Then** show employee, leave dates, type, duration, waiting time and applicable
short-notice/backdating/override/overdue flags,
**And** expose no medical-document metadata through the row.

**Given** multiple tasks,
**When** the queue opens,
**Then** default to longest waiting for the current actor's action and support earliest-
leave-date sort, employee-name search and permitted type/date/exception filters.

**Given** a selected request,
**When** inspecting,
**Then** show permitted calculation, paid/unpaid allocation, employee explanation,
document status and approval history,
**And** retain separate medical-document permission and no private approver-only comments.

**Given** loading/no tasks/no matches/failed refresh,
**When** presenting the queue,
**Then** distinguish states, preserve useful filters/context on Retry and never present
a failed check as no requests awaiting approval.

**Given** desktop/mobile inspection,
**When** opened/closed,
**Then** use shared drawer/full-page patterns and restore queue filter/position/focus,
**And** decision actions belong in review rather than directly on queue rows.

current Approver queue/review and shared collection UX. Failing-first acceptance precedes

privacy, sorting/filter options, no tasks versus no matches versus errors, refresh
without unauthorized retained data, desktop/mobile/focus/return context and safe read-only
inspection. Exact tests/commands and source coverage remain open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind actual request/step/current-assignee query and action-
needed semantics, queue waiting-age anchors and behavior after transfer/return, paging/

As an authorized approver,
I want relevant team absences alongside a request,
So that I can consider team availability before deciding.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an authorized request review,
**When** Team availability loads,
**Then** use requested dates and permitted organization-scoped supervisor/direct-report
grouping without separately maintained teams.

**Given** relevant colleague absences,
**When** availability is presented,
**Then** initially show colleagues with absences in those dates and a concise summary,
**And** grouping itself grants no additional data access.

**When** results display,
**Then** use a compact employee/date timeline emphasizing the requested range on desktop,
and a readable date-grouped list on mobile.

**Given** partial-day leave,
**When** displayed,

placement or exact times.

**And** reveal no type, note, comment or document via API fields/colours/icons/tooltips.

**Then** retain current permitted resource scope,
**And** appointment changes neither reporting relationships nor wider team visibility.

**Given** failed availability load,
**When** the panel reports status,
**Then** show Team availability couldn't be loaded with Retry, not nobody away,
**And** retain other independently usable authorized request details.

**Given** capacity concerns,
**When** deciding,
**Then** treat those as information, not an automatic request/approval blocker,
**And** preserve the separate mandatory applicant approval-responsibility coverage check.

As an authorized approver,
I want to record my decision from request review,
So that leave progresses correctly and the employee understands the result.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an actionable assigned step,
**When** deciding,
**Then** recheck current authority, assignment, revision and self-approval rules,
including effective temporary authority; an old notice/open review gives no continuing grant.

**Given** approval,
**When** confirming,
**Then** allow optional comment and one explicit Approve action, recording actual
actor/time/comment and acting-for attribution where applicable.

**Given** another required decision/finalization condition remains,
**When** the step approval succeeds,
**Then** preserve it without marking the request Approved, retaining applicable
reservations and a clear explanation of outstanding conditions.

**When** committing,
**Then** mark Approved and convert applicable reservations to consumption exactly once,

**Given** rejection,
**When** confirming Reject,
**Then** require a reason labelled Visible to the employee and reject/release applicable
reservations once, preserving prior decisions/history.

**Given** successful decision,
**When** committing,
**Then** record decision/request/balance effects, audit, operation outcome and notification
intent atomically. Use privacy-safe channels, keeping comments in authorized details.

**Given** change/closure/reassignment during review,
**When** confirming,
**Then** refuse the stale action with current permitted outcome, retaining unsent comment
where authorized without overwriting another decision.

**Given** failed/unknown outcome,
**When** recovering,
**Then** keep review/comment available and resolve original operation before safe retry,
**And** after confirmed success return to queue with context, distinguishing your approval
recorded from request approved.

### Story 5.19: Withdraw my pending leave request

**Delivery consolidation — 2026-10-22:** 5.19-A protected employee withdrawal API is
approved and appended below as an earlier handoff prerequisite. General employee browser
boundary 5.19-B is now approved/appended; response-view entry belongs to 5.12-B. Put

**Authority refinement — accepted 2026-10-22, L-0161:** Withdrawal is employee-only;
no on-behalf manager withdrawal permission/default is introduced. An assigned authorized
approver may reject with visible reason; an unassigned manager uses eligible authorized
reassignment. Preserve actual intent/actor and the existing separate E6 cancellation rules.

**Scope approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready.** Group 7/10. Employee
pending withdrawal includes on-behalf-created requests; E1 draft discard and E6
approved cancellation/correction stay separate.

As an employee,
I want to withdraw a request not finally approved,
So that approval stops and its reserved entitlement becomes available again.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** my eligible submitted/in-approval request,
**When** viewing it,
**Then** offer Withdraw request, including on-behalf-created requests and those awaiting
my initial unpaid response.

**Given** withdrawal is selected,
**When** confirming,
**Then** identify type/dates and explain stopped approval/released reserved entitlement,
with Keep request / Withdraw request and no additional approval step.

**Given** confirmation,
**When** processed,
**Then** check current ownership/access, revision and lifecycle,
**And** a stale page cannot withdraw an already Approved request.

**Given** valid withdrawal,
**When** committed,
**Then** mark Withdrawn, release applicable reservations once, close outstanding approval
tasks and atomically record required history/audit/operation outcome/notification intent.

**Given** earlier decisions or attachments,
**When** withdrawal completes,
**Then** preserve permitted history and document associations under current access/retention,
**And** do not turn the request back into an editable draft.

**When** executed,
