or reopening.

**Given** failed/unknown result,
**When** recovering,
**Then** retain current view and resolve/retry the original action safely,
**And** show Withdrawn only on confirmed success and update My Leave.

### Story 5.20: Correct and resubmit my rejected request

**Delivery split — 2026-10-22:** 5.20-A rejected correction/autosave/resubmission API

cycle/rejection display moves with this consumer rather than depend on later full history.

**Preservation refinement — accepted 2026-10-22, L-0159:** Autosave request-scoped
corrections, preserving submitted/rejection history and any separate new-application
draft. Reopen saved corrections without requiring finish/discard of the ordinary draft.
No reservation/approval restart until explicit Resubmit. Apply existing save failure,
current revision/editability and closure safeguards. Exact persistence/association/
concurrency contracts remain open.

**Scope approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready.** Group 7/10 scope discussion
complete. Rejection correction retains the same request ID and historical cycles;
approved cancellation/linked replacement remains E6 under L-0152.

As an employee,
I want to correct a rejected request and submit again,
So that I can address rejection while keeping its history together.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** my rejected request,
**When** viewing,
**Then** prominently show rejection reason and offer Edit and resubmit under current access.

**Given** I choose edit,
**When** the form opens,
**Then** prefill prior details and allow permitted correction,
**And** preserve original submitted details/decisions/rejection reason in history.

**Given** editing,
**When** calculations refresh,
**Then** show revised duration/funding/requirements without reserving entitlement or
restarting approval merely by editing.

**Given** resubmission,
**When** confirming,
**Then** apply current submission validation, required explanations/documents and applicable
initial unpaid acknowledgement to the revised request. A new cycle's initial rules are
not waived by L-0151's later-pending-change simplification.

**Given** valid resubmission,
**When** committed,
**Then** retain request ID and create fresh approval cycle/revised allocation,
**And** historical decisions do not approve revised content.

**Given** a submitting employee eligible for automatic approval,
**When** resubmitting,
**Then** evaluate current self-approval/automatic/finalization rules afresh, not by carrying
an old approval forward.

**Given** successful resubmission,
**When** committed,
**Then** reserve applicable entitlement once or consume once on valid immediate finalization,
with required history/audit/outcome/notification intent atomically,
**And** return to My Leave with authoritative status. Untracked policies keep their own
non-balance usage behavior.

**Given** failed validation, competing edits or unknown result,
**When** recovering,
**Then** preserve useful corrections/history and resolve/retry the original operation
without duplicate cycles or reservations.

**Example:** Rejected 480-minute request corrected to 240 retains its identity and
480-minute submission/rejection history, entering a new cycle/allocation for 240.
No new resubmitted status or linked replacement request.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Features §7/11/13/14, L-0009/0007/0008/0069/
0087/0112/0147/0148/0151, spine AD-2–8/10/11, BIZ-24, FLOW-26/28, rejected-request UX.
Failing-first acceptance precedes code. Verify own access/rejection reason/prefill,
permitted edits with preserved historical values/decisions, no editing reservation,
current validation/initial acknowledgement/new route/authority, same ID/new cycle and
allocation, no old-approval carryover/fresh automatic decision, 480→240 example,
required attachment readiness/identity, duplicate/unknown/stale/competing edits and
actual My Leave/notification integration. Exact test paths/commands remain open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** L-0159 decides autosaved request-scoped corrections
independent of the ordinary draft. Bind exact correction/history representation and
closure without a second competing new-application draft or silent overwrite, permitted
fields/document changes and current revision,
cycle/operation identity, initial acknowledgement evidence and current guard/route/
allocation contracts. Historical snapshots remain prior-cycle evidence; unfinished
supervisor steps in the new cycle follow P-0060/L-0147. Rejection already released old
reservation; prove one revised reservation/consumption and actual document/worker

sizing/readiness remain open.

I want to appoint the intended colleague for specified responsibilities/dates,
So that approval work continues during someone's absence.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a proposed appointment,

return intent, required activity/outcome and notification intent,
**And** apply selected transfers only within effective dates through the actual protected

protected under the agreed appointment lifecycle contract.

**Given** the appointment becomes effective,
**When** work needs action during that period,
**Then** route applicable work to the same Approvals queue with Acting for attribution,
**And** require no appointee acceptance step; the manager confirms availability beforehand.

**Given** appointed authority,
**When** permissions are evaluated,
**Then** grant only specified approval responsibilities, not automatic on-behalf,
cancellation, exceptional-funding or medical-document access.

**Given** changed inputs, unavailable checks or unknown confirmation,

**Then** preserve useful input and recover without duplicate appointment, overlapping
conflicting authority or repeated transfer.

I want temporary assignments to expire and unfinished work to return appropriately,

**Given** an assignment reaches its end,

**Then** deny expired authority even if scheduled return processing is delayed,
**And** do not automatically extend the assignment.

**Given** interrupted or missed processing,
**When** due work is recovered,
**Then** complete applicable return safely without duplicate transfers or notices.

**Given** temporarily unavailable verification,
**When** return cannot be checked,
**Then** retain recoverable pending work and truthful unresolved attention,
**And** expired authority remains expired.

**Given** actual responsibility or coverage changes,
**When** queues and attention refresh,
**Then** show the actual outstanding responsibility and unresolved coverage,
**And** clear coverage attention only with valid cover or an eligible available
original approver.

As an authorized approver,
I want pending requests to reflect the supervisor's return,
So that ordinary approval requirements resume appropriately.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a request awaiting a decision under absence fallback,
**When** the final approver chooses to wait for the supervisor's return,
**Then** keep it pending and visible; an explanatory comment is optional.

**Given** the request is waiting,
**When** reminder or escalation thresholds are reached,
**Then** continue normal processing without pausing timers.

**Given** no final decision has been made,
**When** the supervisor's recorded absence ends,
**Then** restore the outstanding supervisor step under the request's applicable policy,
subject to current eligibility and authority.

**Given** the supervisor step is restored,
**When** approval is attempted,
**Then** enforce required steps again; the final approver cannot complete alone using
the ended absence.

**Given** a valid final decision already completed under fallback,
**When** the supervisor returns,
**Then** preserve that decision without reopening approval.

**Given** an ineligible supervisor or unavailable return verification,
**When** processing the return,
**Then** retain unresolved work pending and flag authorized managers,
**And** do not treat failed verification as permission to continue fallback.

**Given** successful return transition,
**When** responsibility updates,
**Then** refresh the approval queue, notify the supervisor and record the transition
through existing activity/audit.

**Given** return processing races with a decision or is retried,
**When** applying the outcome,
**Then** preserve valid completed decisions and prevent stale fallback authority or
duplicate effects.

and current scoped eligibility, restored outstanding step/queue/notice/activity, denied
ended-absence fallback, valid completed final decision retained, unavailable/ineligible
pending attention, and concurrent return/decision/retry. Verify temporary expiry remains

As an assigned approver,
I want reminders about approvals that currently need my action,
So that waiting requests receive attention.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an unanswered currently required approval,
**When** its policy's reminder interval is reached,
**Then** notify the responsible approver; the default interval is three calendar days.

**Given** other workflow participants,
**When** selecting recipients,
**Then** exclude approvers whose action is not yet required, whose decision is already
recorded or whose step is omitted under the applicable absence policy.

**Given** transferred responsibility,
**When** preparing a reminder,
**Then** check current assignment and authority and do not address outstanding-action
reminders to the former approver.

**Given** completed action or a request no longer awaiting approval,
**When** reminder work runs,
**Then** suppress obsolete reminders.

**Given** a delivered reminder,
**When** its recipient opens it,
**Then** recheck access and show current request state using existing minimal-content
email and in-app notification rules.

waiting for supervisor return does not pause timers. Stories 3.23/3.24/3.25-A/3.25-B

This item still owns actual submission creation, own automatic decisions, draft closure, reservation/association/audit/outcome/intent atomicity and real producer-to-core/source-writer integration. **Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or sized.**
Splits original 5.11 without changing behavior; browser submission remains separate.

As an employee,
I want my reviewed leave submission recorded reliably,
So that the request and its accounting effects have one trustworthy outcome.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** my current application revision and reviewed submission input,
**When** the API receives submission,
**Then** recheck current employee/access, draft revision/editability and all applicable
submission/route/duration/funding/employment/document/coverage and initial unpaid-response
rules using authoritative inputs,
**And** require initial own unpaid acknowledgement to match the exact current amount;
materially changed reviewed consequences require renewed review under existing rules.

**Given** valid submission,
**When** the transaction commits,
**Then** create one permanent request and approval cycle, applicable reservation,
draft closure and required evidence/audit/operation outcome/notification intent together,
**And** preserve verified document associations. Untracked policies have no fictional
entitlement effects. Record required-step/policy evidence and eligible assignments under
P-0060/L-0147/0160, not permanently frozen unfinished supervisor assignments.

**Given** an authorized submitting approver with explicitly permitted self-approval,
**When** automatic decisions are evaluated,
**Then** record only currently authorized own decisions under the existing configured
step rules including L-0158,
**And** finalize/consume once only if all decisions and independent conditions pass;
otherwise remain pending with reservations and outstanding reasons.

**Given** an accepted or uncertain submission operation,
**When** its outcome is queried or retried,
**Then** recover original committed success or safely retry that same operation/payload
only when known safe; retain unknown outcomes truthfully without a new submission,
**And** duplicate clicks, response loss or late autosaves cannot duplicate requests/
accounting or reopen the closed draft.

**Given** an authenticated employee reading the submitted result,
**When** the minimum own-request read is requested,
**Then** return only currently authorized own-organization request information, including
identity, submitted type/dates/duration/note/funding and authoritative status/outstanding
reason needed by its result/detail consumer,
**And** exclude unauthorized medical-document metadata and internal approver absence/
cover information. This is not the full calendar/history query or approver workspace.

**Given** the first real submitted requests,
**When** relevant E2/E3 inputs or supervisor assignments change,
**Then** actual owning writers participate in the required request-impact/current-authority
protection before this consumer can be treated as complete,
**And** required notification intent uses actual E3 handover/delivery integration. Rule
fixtures and future group-10 proof are not substitutes for these consumer checks.

**Inherited requirements (not reopened):** Original 5.11, Stories 5.1–5.10, E1 draft
lifecycle, E3 accounting/delivery, E4 association and accepted ADR precedence apply.
L-0148 original-outcome Retry, L-0154 completion reassessment, L-0158 same-person decision
and L-0161 withdrawal boundaries remain. Own-read results do not trigger approval.
Preserve initiator/executor attribution and no remote waits under business locks.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Original 5.11 AC ownership table below;
BIZ-14–16/19/23/29–31, FLOW-01–08/25/28, applicable PRIV-04/05/10/21/22; Features §7/
9–11/13/14, P-0030/0033/0060 and Leave 0007/0008/0112/0135/0147/0148/0154/0158/0160.
Observe relevant failing API acceptance before implementation; use actual owner contracts
and storage to verify atomic success/rollback, current input/authority and no-bypass
conditions, own exact acknowledgement, immediate versus pending result, tracked/untracked
accounting, preserved associations/closed draft, original-operation recovery and late
save/finalization races. Verify minimum own-read scope/privacy and actual writer/notification
integration. Browser tests belong to 5.11-B; transport internals retain E3 owner suites.
Exact source/test paths/commands/contracts remain open; no tests executed.

### Story 5.11-B: Submit through Apply and see the confirmed result

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or sized.**
Consumes completed 5.11-A; extracts minimum real detail/result from 5.30/5.31.

As an employee,
I want to submit through Apply and see the confirmed result on My Leave,
So that I can finish applying and open my submitted request without uncertainty.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** the existing Apply form is ready for submission,
**When** reviewing,
**Then** render concise type/dates/duration/paid-requested-unpaid summary, organization
and field-adjacent blockers using current API evidence,
**And** collect the exact initial unpaid acknowledgement where needed; fully paid input
uses one Submit request action without another confirmation screen.

**Given** explicit Submit request,
**When** calling 5.11-A,
**Then** use the reviewed current revision and render its validation/material-change
outcome without client-side replacement of authoritative rules,
**And** prevent a new submission while its original outcome is unresolved.

**Given** confirmed success,
**When** applying the outcome,
**Then** close Apply and return to My Leave with useful list/scroll/focus context,
brief Request submitted, an authoritative request row/status and optional View request,
**And** remove the submitted-draft note without automatically opening details, prominently
displaying a reference/next approver or claiming pending means Approved.

**Given** the submitted row or View request link,
**When** selected,
**Then** open the reusable own-request detail panel on desktop or mobile detail page,
showing permitted submitted type/dates/duration/note/funding and concise actual status,
**And** closing restores useful My Leave context. Future calendar/full history/action
surfaces extend this same detail surface rather than duplicate it.

**Given** failure, material change or uncertain outcome,
**When** recovering,
**Then** preserve recoverable entered input, present field correction/review or Retry
as applicable and use 5.11-A original-operation recovery,
**And** do not add Check status, falsely confirm submission or start a different attempt
while unresolved. Lost responses, double clicks and late saves retain inherited protections.

**Given** submission succeeds but its My Leave refresh fails,
**When** displaying the page,
**Then** retain the known committed submission outcome, show the failed read with Retry
and keep other authorized content usable,
**And** do not invite resubmission, fabricate an empty list or erase valid existing context.

**Given** desktop/mobile, keyboard or assistive-technology use,
**When** completing review/submission/recovery/detail navigation,
**Then** provide accessible labels/status feedback and usable focus/return behavior
under existing shared interaction patterns.

**Inherited requirements (not reopened):** Original 5.11 and completed 5.11-A own domain
validation, accounting/draft closure, current scope, operation outcome and notifications.
E1 autosave/lifecycle/session recovery and current privacy/document rules remain. No
placeholder future action buttons, wider colleague fields or routine absence/cover leaks.
Initial on-behalf response, expanded history/cycles and full year/calendar/dashboard
composition remain separate residual consumers, not acceptance dependencies here.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Original 5.11 AC allocation table, extracted
5.30 AC1/minimum detail and 5.31 submitted-result/direct-entry/context/partial-failure
portions; Features §7/14, Apply/My Leave/current partial-loading UX, L-0071/0087/0123/
0148 and related shared interaction patterns. Observe failing rendered acceptance before
implementation. Verify real 5.11-A calls and exact paid/unpaid review, changed review,
submission success/unknown/duplicate/lost response, truthful pending/immediate Approved,
submitted draft-note removal, minimum detail/close return, post-success read failure,
current access/session and keyboard/mobile behavior. Use existing domain owner evidence
rather than duplicate full API/notification suites. Exact test paths/commands remain open.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind typed API errors/outcomes, reviewed-revision versus
in-flight save coordination, recovery identity, minimal own-request list/read and
summary fields, post-success invalidation and context/focus. API and required generic
patterns must exist first; missing domain rules belong to the owning prerequisite,
not client fallbacks. Pull minimum consumers forward without relying on later 5.30/
5.31 handlers. Boundary approval is not proof of one-session sizing; split further if
rendered integration exceeds the bound. Contracts, final source/test coverage/dependency

As an authorized on-behalf submitter and the employee receiving that request,
I want a reliable submission and employee-only response handoff,
So that recorded leave can complete without proxy acknowledgement or missing handlers.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an actor selecting an employee for initial on-behalf submission,
**When** employee lookup or submission is attempted,
**Then** enforce current explicit capability and target organization/resource scope,
**And** apply L-0149 standard Approver mapping without inferring authority from temporary
appointment, approval assignment or coarse correction grants.

**Given** scoped employee input and an on-behalf reason,
**When** processing submission,
**Then** use that employee's policy/schedule/allocation and current ordinary guards,
**And** atomically commit request/cycle/accounting/audit/outcome/notification intent while
attributing employee separately from actor and leaving the employee's ordinary draft
untouched. Reuse 5.11-A protections without closing or replacing the employee's draft.

**Given** the submitter owns an authorized approval position,
**When** submission records automatic decisions,
**Then** satisfy only their currently permitted own position(s) under accepted rules,
including later-step and L-0158 handling,
**And** do not bypass another person's required decision or other finalization gate.

**Given** initial unpaid on-behalf leave,
**When** submission commits,
**Then** record the outstanding employee-only response with exact current unpaid amount,
expose it through authorized own-request reads and commit required minimal employee
notification intent,
**And** retain pending status/reservations even if the submitter's decisions satisfy
all approval steps. Fully paid requests create no initial unpaid response obligation.

**Given** an outstanding initial response,
**When** acknowledgement is submitted,
**Then** require the employee's current own access and current request/allocation/revision
and exact amount evidence,
**And** deny proxy acknowledgement, stale amount confirmation and responses to closed work.

**Given** valid employee acknowledgement,
**When** the command completes,
**Then** record the response/actual actor and trigger current finalization under L-0154,
consuming once only if every condition passes; otherwise remain pending with reasons.
Valid prior decisions are not repeated. L-0151 later-change notices do not create renewed
response gates; an existing outstanding initial response uses current evidence.

**Given** a duplicate, lost-response, uncertain or concurrent submission/acknowledgement,
**When** recovering or retrying,
**Then** resolve the original operation without duplicate requests, responses, consumption
or reopened work, preserving separate employee draft and truthful committed outcome.

**Given** a notification is read or employee withdrawal occurs,
**When** projecting required response/action state,
**Then** reading is not acknowledgement and cannot finalize the request,
**And** an employee may use the completed ordinary withdrawal command instead of responding;
withdrawal closes the obligation and prevents later acknowledgement/finalization.

funding, coverage and response rules; 5.11-A operation/owner integration; L-0151/0154/
0158/0161 and current E3 notification/access boundaries. No new response workspace,
manager proxy consent or default administrative withdrawal. No remote waits under
business locks. Original 5.14's later pending-change behavior is consumer integration

### Story 5.12-B: Submit for an employee and complete the initial response in the browser

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or sized.**
Consumes completed 5.12-A and reusable 5.11-B detail/review/recovery components.

As an authorized on-behalf submitter and the employee receiving the request,
I want usable submission and initial response screens,
So that each person can complete their own part of the handoff.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** current scoped initial on-behalf access,
**When** opening the form,
**Then** show an authorized employee picker, persistent employee/recording-actor context
and required on-behalf reason; use the selected employee's applicable values.

**Given** completed input,
**When** reviewing and submitting,
**Then** show employee, dates, duration, allocation, reason and actual approval consequence,
and call 5.12-A on explicit Submit for employee,
**And** render confirmed pending/approved outcome without proxy unpaid acknowledgement
or disturbing the employee's separate draft.

**Given** an initial unpaid request submitted on my behalf,
**When** I open My Leave or its authorized notification link,
**Then** show Your response is needed near the top and open the existing request detail
with exact current unpaid amount and paid/unpaid breakdown,
**And** allow only my own explicit acknowledgement through the completed response API.

**Given** the unpaid amount changed before I respond,
**When** the stale response is rejected or refreshed,
**Then** show current amount and permitted explanation and require review of current
response evidence, preserving useful context,
**And** do not introduce a renewed-response gate for later changes after initial response
is satisfied (L-0151).

**Given** confirmed employee acknowledgement,
**When** its result is displayed,
**Then** remove the fulfilled response prompt, refresh actual request/balance state and
show Approved only if API finalization committed; otherwise show the remaining pending
reason without asking anyone to repeat valid approval.

**Given** I prefer withdrawing an eligible pending request,
**When** using the existing ordinary withdrawal alternative from this response view,
**Then** show the existing Keep request / Withdraw request confirmation and call the
completed employee-only withdrawal API,
**And** reflect actual closure rather than require acknowledgement. No manager withdrawal
option is introduced.

**Given** validation, lost access, closed work, failure or unknown operation outcome,
**When** recovering submission or response,
**Then** use existing current-state/Retry handling, preserve recoverable input/context
and do not claim success or start a duplicate action while unresolved. Reading the
notification does not dismiss the required business response.

**Given** desktop/mobile or keyboard/assistive use,
**When** moving through the actor form and employee detail/response,
**Then** retain accessible summary/action/status, useful close/return focus and current
organization/user privacy; actor switching must not expose the previous user's data.

### Story 5.19-A: Withdraw my pending request through the protected API

**Commitment extraction approved — 2026-10-23:** Consume completed 5.8-A protected

Exact contracts/size remain open.

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or sized.**
Earlier prerequisite after own-request persistence and before on-behalf response consumers.

As an employee,
I want a protected operation to withdraw my pending request,
So that its outstanding work stops and reserved entitlement is released reliably.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a withdrawal command for a submitted/in-approval request,
**When** processing it,
**Then** require current employee ownership/access, organization scope, matching request
revision and eligible pending lifecycle,
**And** deny withdrawal of another employee's request or an already Approved/closed
request under L-0161. Original on-behalf submission does not alter ownership.

**Given** a valid explicit withdrawal,
**When** committing,
**Then** mark Withdrawn, release applicable reservations once and close outstanding
approval tasks/response obligations with required history/audit/outcome/notification
intent atomically,
**And** preserve untracked usage semantics without fictional balance release.

**Given** previous decisions or associated documents,
**When** withdrawal completes,
**Then** retain permitted immutable history and document associations under current
access/retention,
**And** do not convert the request into an editable draft or change the employee's
separate ordinary application draft.

**Given** a request already withdrawn,
**When** later consequential activity attempts to act on it,
**Then** lifecycle/revision enforcement rejects further approval/response/finalization
or stale save resurrection, returning a safe current outcome where access permits.

**Given** concurrent withdrawal and current finalization,
**When** operations compete,
**Then** only a valid lifecycle transition commits, without double release/consumption,
reopening or partial audit/notification effects.

**Given** duplicate or uncertain withdrawal execution,
**When** querying or retrying its original operation,
**Then** recover the committed result or safely retry without duplicate effects,
**And** return unknown truthfully rather than report Withdrawn before confirmed success.

**Given** authorized own-request/result reads after withdrawal,
**When** returning the result,
**Then** expose the committed Withdrawn status and current action availability needed
by existing detail/list consumers, without leaking private content or retaining a live
required-response indication for closed work.

**Inherited requirements (not reopened):** Original 5.19/L-0161 employee-only authority,
E1 draft lifecycle, 5.11-A current request/operation/accounting foundation, E3 notification
handover and E4 association rules. No approved cancellation, manager withdrawal permission,
new workflow state or remote waits under business locks. Timed reminder relevance uses
closed state through existing owner contracts; future reminder generation is not
implemented solely to prove this command.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Original 5.19 AC allocation below; Features
§7/11/13/14/state models, BIZ-23, FLOW-25, L-0148/0161 and platform lifecycle/transaction/
attachment safeguards. Observe failing API acceptance before implementation. Verify real
own submitted request withdrawal, current scope/other employee/manager denial, terminal
state and stale revision, actual one-time release/task closure/audit/outcome/notification,
retained decisions/associations and separate draft, duplicate/unknown result and race
with existing own-submission finalization. Verify contracts against controlled not-yet-
introduced actor/response variants without claiming real later producers were exercised.
When 5.12-A and 5.18 arrive, those consumers own actual acknowledgement/decision race
integration. Exact source/test paths/commands remain open; no runtime tests executed.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind eligibility/revision/cycle/action closure, reservation
release and immutable evidence/association references, current actor/owner access,
notification recipient/relevance and operation/outcome contracts. Consume completed
5.11-A persistence/current authorization; do not depend on later browser, on-behalf or
approver command implementation. Shared terminal-state protection must exist now;
later commands consume it and prove their real additional races. Boundary approval is
not single-agent sizing PASS. Contracts, final atomic coverage/order/sizing/readiness open.

**Impacts:** Scaffold: consume/prove protected lifecycle/revision/outcome/atomic audit/
outbox patterns and promote generic gaps with first consumer. Shared UI: following
browser items reuse typed outcome/conflict contracts. Leave owns withdrawal semantics.
Agent context: existing rules suffice. Documentation: original AC-owner mapping and exact
API/source/test evidence; epics/tracker/handoff. ADR: no new decision for split. No code,
runtime tests, migrations, grants, deployment or implementation/readiness authorization.

So that I can stop a pending application and see its confirmed outcome.

**Given** my current eligible pending request,

Exact contracts/size remain open.

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or sized.**
Owns decision commands and minimum authorized assigned-request read/review evidence.

As a currently authorized assigned approver,
I want a protected approval or rejection operation,
So that my decision progresses the request with correct authority and accounting.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a request for inspection or decision,
**When** the assigned read/command executes,
**Then** require current organization/resource scope, actionable assignment, membership,
request revision and applicable self/temporary authority; old notices or open reviews
supply no continuing authority,
**And** return only permitted current request/review evidence, honoring separate document
permissions and excluding unrelated absence/cover details.

**Given** explicit approval,
**When** recorded,
**Then** accept an optional comment and record actual actor/time/comment/authority basis
and temporary acting-for attribution,
**And** apply L-0158 one-confirmation consecutive same-person rules without satisfying
another person's required decision.

**Given** remaining decisions or independent gates,
**When** an intermediate approval commits,
**Then** retain that decision, pending request/reservations and outstanding reasons;
otherwise finalization rechecks every condition and commits Approved/consumption once
without repeating earlier valid decisions. Untracked usage has no fictional balances.

**Given** explicit rejection,
**When** executed,
**Then** require an employee-visible reason, reject/release once and preserve earlier
decisions/history. Comments remain in authorized details, not notification payloads.

**Given** valid decision effects,
**When** committing,
**Then** record step/request/accounting effects, consequential audit, operation outcome
and required notification intent atomically, using actual E3 delivery integration.

**Given** changed/withdrawn/reassigned/expired or otherwise stale work,
**When** a decision is attempted,
**Then** refuse stale authority/lifecycle with permitted current outcome and do not
overwrite completed decisions, duplicate effects or reopen closed work.

**Given** competing approval/employee response/withdrawal or uncertain/duplicate attempts,
**When** commands race or recover,
**Then** use original-operation outcome and protected finalization boundaries, preserving
one valid lifecycle/accounting result and distinguishing recorded step approval from
overall Approved. Browser comment retention/queue return are separate presentation work.

current authority/finalization and initial-response contracts as introduced; L-0147/

mandatory unless authorized exception. Missing checks never become waived. No standalone
exceptional allocation or new funding grant is introduced here; 5.13's later combined
command uses the completed protected decision/finalization mechanism.

### Story 5.16-A: Query my actionable approval queue and permitted inspection data

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or sized.**
Reuses 5.18-A assigned-read/current-authority evidence and owns residual queue queries.

As an authorized approver,
I want current actionable work and permitted request inspection from the API,
So that my workspace can identify and explain the approvals I may act on.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a current authorized actor,
**When** querying actionable work,
**Then** return only organization/resource-scoped steps needing that actor's action,
excluding completed, omitted or not-yet-actionable later steps,
**And** apply current supervisor/temporary scope, membership and expiry observations;
old notifications and cached rows are not authority.

**Given** ordinary or temporary work,
**When** projecting results,
**Then** include both in the same query with permitted employee/type/dates/duration,
waiting time, acting-for/end-date and applicable notice/backdating/override/overdue flags,
**And** omit medical-document metadata or private content from queue rows.

**Given** supported query options,
**When** sorting/searching/filtering/paging,
**Then** default to longest waiting for the current required action and support earliest
leave date, employee-name search and permitted type/date/exception filters with stable
results under the bound query contract,
**And** derive action counts, if exposed, from required tasks rather than unread notices.

**Given** an authorized selected request,
**When** querying residual inspection,
**Then** reuse minimum assigned read and return permitted calculation/allocation,
employee explanation, document provision/readiness status and approval history,
**And** enforce separate sensitive-document authorization with no metadata leak or
private approver-only comment feature.

**Given** no actionable work or no filter matches,
**When** returning a successful query,
**Then** distinguish the result as required by the query contract,
**And** do not map missing authority or unavailable required verification to a successful
empty queue. Use safe typed failure/denial instead of business-content disclosure.

**Given** changed responsibility or access,
**When** querying or refreshing,
**Then** reflect current permitted work and reject stale assigned inspection appropriately,
preserving completed decisions and L-0156 waiting-clock semantics without granting new
scope from supervisor grouping or delegation.

**Inherited requirements (not reopened):** Original 5.16 current-action/privacy/history/
query behavior; 5.18-A owns minimum assigned read and decision command. P-0060/L-0147/
0156/0160 govern current responsibility/waiting identity. E4 sensitive-document read
contracts remain separate. No decision endpoints or future browser safety dependency
is added; no team master or private-comment subsystem.

§10/15/16/18, BIZ-22, FLOW-24, PRIV-02–04/06/11/13/14; approved collection UX and

before implementation. Verify actual ordinary/temp/current-supervisor request queries,

filters/page stability and success-empty versus denial/verification failure. Reference

integration, not duplicate mechanics. Exact tests/commands/contracts remain open;

**Commitment extraction approved — 2026-10-23:** Consume completed 5.8-A protected
request commitment/settlement and guard interface once. This item's actual domain
validation, source/decision/state change and complete atomic producer integration remain
here; no repeated reserve/consume/release storage or second ledger. Reallocation/correction
extends the same representation only in its actual authorized consuming scope. Final
contracts/order/size/readiness remain open.

**Zero-unpaid refinement accepted — 2026-10-23, L-0162:** An authorized change to zero closes the outstanding initial on-behalf response without employee acknowledgement; preserve history and reassess all gates. Later same-cycle unpaid changes notify without reopening; new cycles apply initial rules. Actual allocation/response writer integration and race evidence remain required.

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or sized.**
Consumes E3 source/calculation contracts and completed ordinary decision mechanism 5.18-A.

As an actor authorized for exceptional funding,
I want protected funding review and confirmation operations,
So that permitted allocation and any combined approval have one trustworthy outcome.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an authorized request funding review,
**When** proposals are queried,
**Then** return current requested duration, eligible available/projected funding,
protected reservations/shortfall and proposed paid/unpaid split,
**And** treat unpaid as a default proposal, not an already approved outcome.

**Given** explicit allocation confirmation,
**When** checking authority,
**Then** require the current scoped exceptional-funding capability and one exception
reason, validating source/employee/organization/date/amount/expiry/reservations as business
rules rather than permission per funding line,
**And** do not infer unrelated standalone balance adjustment or funding rights from
ordinary approval/on-behalf/temporary authority.

**Given** explicit permitted source/duration lines,
**When** validating allocation,
**Then** account for the entire request exactly once across eligible balances,
request-specific discretionary paid grants and unpaid portions with linked authorizer/
reason/provenance,
**And** preserve date validity/expiry/reservations without silent cross-type borrowing,
recurring-entitlement rewrite or a new negative-paid borrowing default.

**Given** funding-only or combined confirmation,
**When** processing the selected operation,
**Then** funding-only records no approval decision; combined requires both current
capabilities and the actor's actionable approval position through completed 5.18-A,
**And** commit distinct allocation/source and actual decision effects/evidence/outcome/
notification intent atomically or neither. A reason is not a substitute for funding records.

**Given** a changed pending allocation,
**When** committing consequences,
**Then** retain previous/revised amounts and actor/reason, commit required employee notice
and expose authorized detail without renewed response under L-0151,
**And** preserve an independently outstanding initial on-behalf response and current amount
checks, valid decisions and all other finalization gates; use L-0154 reassessment where applicable.

**Given** stale inputs/authority, competing requests or unknown/duplicate confirmation,
**When** executing or recovering,
**Then** revalidate or recover the original operation without duplicate grants,
reservations/consumption/decisions or partial combined effects,
**And** return permitted current review/actual outcome evidence rather than guess success.

**Inherited requirements (not reopened):** Original 5.13/L-0150/0151 single capability,
reason/source rules, E3 allocation/calculation, current protected reservations, 5.18-A
ordinary decisions and 5.12-A initial employee response where introduced. Untracked
policies retain their distinct semantics; no per-line grant UI, approval tier or new
source catalogue is invented. Real E2/E3 writer coordination and no remote waits under
business locks remain. Later browser code cannot supply command atomicity/authority.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Original 5.13 allocation below; Features §6/
9/10, BIZ-18, CALC-25, E3 Story 3.21 and allocation-review UX, L-0032/0088/0112/0128/
0150/0151/0154. Observe failing API acceptance before implementation. Verify actual
scoped capability/invalid source denial, mixed permitted lines and entire-duration/date
reconciliation, request-specific grant provenance, one reason, funding-only versus
combined actor/step authority, all-or-neither distinct effects/audit/outcome/intent,
current unpaid initial-versus-later rules and notices, actual 5.18-A/5.12-A integration,
stale/conflict/unknown/retry and no double funding/consumption. Reference owner suites
for generic delivery/guards; exact tests/commands/contracts remain open. No runtime tests.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Bind capability/default/custom mappings, permitted source/
limits/provenance, proposal/review token/revision and current amount, funding-only/combined
operation identities and composable ordinary decision transaction, writer/calculation
observations, atomic local evidence/outcome/notification and actual employee response

### Story 5.13-B: Review exceptional funding and confirm the permitted action

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or sized.**

As an actor authorized for exceptional funding,

So that I can resolve a request's funding with understood consequences.

**Given** a permitted funding review,

shortfall and proposed paid/unpaid split from 5.13-A,

**Given** permitted alternatives,
**When** entering allocation,
**Then** allow explicit supported source/duration lines and one exception reason,
show reconciled full-request consequences and do not silently change sources,

borrowing controls beyond approved supported sources.

**When** reviewing confirmation,
**Then** offer funding-only confirmation or one Approve with exception as authorized,
using the completed API and clearly distinguishing funding resolution from approval.

**Given** confirmed success,

refresh relevant review/balance/status and retain useful return context,

**Given** changed evidence/authority, conflict or uncertain result,
**When** recovering,
**Then** preserve entered allocation/reason only while authorized and use current review/
original-operation Retry without duplicate actions or false success,
**And** distinguish confirmed mutation from a later failed read-refresh.

**Given** desktop/mobile or keyboard/assistive use,
**When** editing lines, reviewing consequences and confirming,
**Then** provide usable controls, accessible errors/status and appropriate focus/context
through existing shared patterns.

### Story 5.15-A: Integrate one-off balance adjustments with actual pending requests

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or sized.**
One writer family: existing E3 one-off adjustment API (original 3.29), not a new impact service.

As an authorized balance-adjustment author,
I want pending-request consequences included in the protected adjustment operation,
So that the change cannot silently alter employees' leave arrangements.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an authorized proposed one-off adjustment,
**When** reviewing through the existing adjustment API,
**Then** discover actual affected pending requests and return permitted before/after
funding/eligibility consequences with current source/request evidence,
**And** review itself creates no adjustment, reservation or notification effect.

**Given** consequential pending-request changes,
**When** confirming adjustment,
**Then** require current adjustment authority, unchanged reviewed material consequences
and an employee-visible explanation under existing reason rules,
**And** record actual adjustment/request/accounting evidence, actor/reason, operation
outcome and required notification intent consistently with the owning protected writes.

**Given** later pending paid/unpaid changes,
**When** applying reviewed effects,
**Then** retain prior/revised amounts and employee notice/detail links without renewed
acknowledgement under L-0151,
**And** preserve current applicability of an independently outstanding initial unpaid
response, valid prior decisions and every other finalization condition.

**Given** unresolved request consequences,
**When** completing the adjustment under applicable rules,
**Then** preserve actual request dates/history and valid decisions without automatic
rejection/cancellation/trimming, exposing permitted unresolved detail/attention evidence,
**And** require each separate remedy's current authority rather than transfer permissions
or automatically grant exceptional funding. Reassess only under L-0154's bound triggers.

**Given** changed source/request inputs, competing decisions, unavailable impact checks
or uncertain/repeated confirmation,
**When** executing or recovering,
**Then** protect current review/reservations/revisions, refuse or renew changed material
review and recover original effects without duplicate adjustment/consumption/notice,
**And** never treat unavailable impact verification as no affected requests.

**Given** ordinary projected accrual/expiry/rollover or approved requests,
**When** evaluating the adjustment's impact,
**Then** preserve normal projected-time and separate approved-request safeguards;
do not invent unpaid increases solely from routine time passage, rewrite approved paid
leave or use this pending-only integration as authority for an E6 correction.

**Inherited requirements (not reopened):** Original 5.15/L-0151, original 3.29 source

### Story 5.15-D: Review pending-request impacts of recurring entitlement changes

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or sized.**

**Given** a recurring-entitlement or return-to-policy proposal,
**When** reviewing through 5.15-C,

**When** selected within current permission,
**Then** open its real authorized detail/action and return to useful entitlement-review

provide accessible desktop/mobile feedback, focus and return behavior throughout.

### Story 5.15-E: Integrate policy publication with pending-request impacts

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or sized.**
Source family: actual E3 used-policy publication API 3.34-A and its existing timing mechanism.

As an authorized policy-change author,
I want pending-request effects included in protected policy publication,
So that a policy version cannot silently alter existing leave arrangements.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a valid proposed policy version,
**When** reviewing through the actual source API,
**Then** return permitted affected pending requests and before/after consequences
alongside affected employees/overrides and effective/first-usable dates,
**And** create no effects from review or claim allowance changes hidden by continuing overrides.

**Given** current authority and unchanged consequential source/request review evidence,
**When** confirming publication,
**Then** preserve immutable source versions and commit required protected pending-request
effects, actor/explanation/evidence/outcome/notice through the owning writes,
**And** retain source field/in-use restrictions and approved-request protections.

**Given** immediate or future publication and employee-specific dates,
**When** representing/applying its pending consequences,
**Then** distinguish current/scheduled policy and effective/first-usable funding correctly,
preserving the existing owner calculation/effective-date behavior,
**And** do not invent worker-posted accrual or imply future changes apply immediately.

**Given** later paid/unpaid pending changes,
**When** applying actual effects,
**Then** retain previous/revised amounts and required employee notice/explanation without
renewed response under L-0151, preserving any independently outstanding initial response,
valid decisions, reservations and all independent gates. Use only bound L-0154 reassessment triggers.

**Given** changed authority/affected set, competing request/publication operations,

**When** confirming or recovering,
**Then** renew materially changed review or recover the original operation without
duplicate versions/request/accounting/notice effects,
**And** never treat missing impact verification as no affected requests.

**Given** a scoped calculation-relevant calendar-entry proposal,
**When** reviewing through the actual source API,
**Then** find permitted affected pending requests through actual applicable calendar/
profile/default/override dependencies and return before/after duration/funding/eligibility
consequences with required explanation,
**And** review creates no calendar/request effects.

**Given** full/partial holiday or closure data,
**When** computing consequences,
**Then** use current effective employee schedule/calendar version/work timezone and
existing source date/overlap/partial-time contracts,
**And** do not infer universal day length, arbitrary exact times or a holiday provider.

**Given** current authority and unchanged material calendar/dependency/request review,
**When** confirming,
**Then** retain stable calendar identity and versioned history while coordinating
protected pending effects with required actor/explanation/calculation evidence/audit/
outcome/notice through owning writes,
**And** preserve prior recorded request/calculation references and valid decisions.

**Given** reviewed pending consequences,
**When** applying effects,
**Then** retain actual dates/reservations/independent gates and expose authorized unresolved
detail/attention without silent recalculation/trimming/cancellation/unpaid conversion,
**And** use L-0151 prior/revised amount/explanation/notice without renewed acknowledgement,
retaining outstanding initial response and bound L-0154 reassessment. Approved-request
and E6 correction safeguards remain separate.

**Given** calendar applicability or unrelated settings,
**When** an entry is added/edited/removed,
**Then** preserve the source's effective/history rules and do not assign profiles or
silently change employee schedule/timezone/overrides, membership or shared People facts.

**Given** changed entry/dependent/request set or authority, competing actions, unavailable
impact checks or unknown/repeated confirmation,
**When** confirming or recovering,
**Then** renew material review or recover original effects without duplicate calendar/
request/accounting/notices, and missing verification is never no affected requests.

**Inherited requirements (not reopened):** Original 5.15/E2 2.18, stable/versioned calendar,
actual schedule/date/calculation/current scope/request/response/notice contracts. No new
calendar editor/statutory engine/import, generic impact service or administrative draft.
Configuration retains explicit Save/Review/Confirm and short transactions without remote

### Story 5.20-A: Preserve corrections and resubmit a rejected request through the API

**Commitment extraction approved — 2026-10-23:** Consume completed 5.8-A protected

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or sized.**
Consumes actual own-request/rejection and submission guard/effect foundations; browser independent.

As an employee,
I want my rejected-request corrections saved and explicitly resubmitted reliably,
So that I can address rejection without losing history or duplicating the request.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** my currently authorized rejected request,
**When** reading correction context,
**Then** return permitted prior submitted details, rejection/decisions and current saved
corrections for that request; retain immutable historical cycle evidence separately from editable input.

**Given** current request-scoped correction revision/editability,
**When** saving unfinished corrections,
**Then** preserve input under L-0159 and established lightweight autosave protections,
without reserving entitlement/restarting approval or altering the separate ordinary draft,
**And** retain current ownership/access/structural/revision/lifecycle checks rather than
require calculation setup needed only for consequential resubmission.

**Given** explicit Resubmit with current reviewed correction evidence,
**When** validating,
**Then** reuse current submission guard/route/calculation/document/initial acknowledgement
mechanisms and materially changed-review rules,
**And** apply the new cycle's initial response rules, not L-0151's later-change notice
exception; on-behalf correction grants are not inferred from initial submission authority.

**Given** valid resubmission,
**When** committing,
**Then** retain request ID, close the editable correction revision and create one fresh
approval cycle/revised allocation with required history/audit/outcome/notification intent
and reservation or valid immediate-finalization consumption atomically,
**And** preserve earlier submitted details/rejection/decisions without carrying old decisions
forward. Rejection already released the old reservation; do not create a second request.

**Given** current automatic-decision eligibility,
**When** the fresh cycle is created,
**Then** re-evaluate current self-approval/assignment/L-0158/finalization rules,
never reuse a historical approval as authority for revised content. Untracked policies
retain non-balance usage semantics without fictional entitlement effects.

**Given** corrected versus historical document associations,
**When** preserving edits and resubmitting,
**Then** retain historical references/current permissions and verified-byte/association
safety while validating the new cycle's required attachments; cleanup must not remove
protected historical/current or in-flight associations.

**Given** validation failure, concurrent edits, late autosaves or unknown/duplicate resubmit,
**When** recovering,
**Then** preserve authorized saved corrections/history and resolve the original operation
without duplicate cycles/accounting/notice or reopening the closed correction revision,
**And** expose actual current request/cycle status through the existing own-read foundation.

**Inherited requirements (not reopened):** Original 5.20/L-0159 and completed 5.11-A,
5.18-A request/rejection/guard/current authority/effect/outcome contracts, E1 saving rules,

steps. No new resubmitted lifecycle state, E6 linked replacement, admin draft or automatic
ordinary draft overwrite. Remote waits remain outside business locks.

commands/contracts open. No runtime tests executed.

### Story 5.21-A: Create a bounded temporary appointment and apply its authorized pending work

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-22. Not implementation-ready or finally sized.**

As an authorized Leave Manager,
I want to appoint my chosen colleague for specified responsibilities and dates,
So that the intended colleague can handle authorized work during the absence.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** current scoped appointment authority,
**When** reviewing a chosen original/temporary approver, responsibilities and interval,
**Then** validate current organization membership, known absence, self-approval and overlap
rules using the completed eligibility mechanisms, without requiring a permanent Approver
role or recommending a substitute automatically.

**Given** eligible real pending approval steps,
**When** preparing appointment confirmation,
**Then** return the selectable work and reviewed selected effects, required reason and
conditional return to the original approver subject to eligibility,
**And** apply the original final approver's configured absence policy without an additional
fallback permission or appointee acceptance step.

**Given** valid current confirmation,
**When** committing the appointment,
**Then** persist the bounded responsibility, reviewed selected-work authorization,
conditional-return basis and required local activity/outcome/notification and durable
start/expiry intent consistently, preserving owner boundaries and actual initiator.
Do not claim a distributed atomic grant across Access and Leave.

**Given** an appointment effective now or at a future start,
**When** its effective start is processed,
**Then** apply only currently valid authorized responsibilities and selected unfinished
work through the completed protected transfer mechanism at the applicable dates,
**And** expose actual responsibility in the existing Approvals queue with Acting for
attribution, preserving completed decisions, selected final approvers and waiting clocks.
The actual effective-start processing belongs here, not a future handler.

**Given** the appointment created through this API,
**When** its recorded interval ends,
**Then** the completed 5.23-A consumer recognizes its real persisted authority/return
and due-work evidence, denies expired authority and performs eligible conditional return
or retains truthful pending/coverage attention under current replacement precedence.
Prove actual creation-to-start/queue-to-expiry/return integration before activation.

**Given** temporary responsibility,
**When** the appointee reads or acts,
**Then** enforce only the specified approval scope and interval, with no automatic
on-behalf submission, cancellation, exceptional-funding or medical-document rights,
**And** expose the minimum authorized appointment review/result read for its browser.

**Given** changed membership, absence, source supervisor, selected-step or appointment state,
**When** confirmation or scheduled work executes,
**Then** recheck current applicable evidence and revisions without overriding newer valid
state, granting early/expired authority or repeating a transfer; unavailable verification
remains recoverable and does not declare the candidate eligible.

**Given** concurrent confirmations, interrupted start processing or an unknown result,
**When** recovery/retry resumes,
**Then** resolve the original operation and durable work without duplicate appointments,
conflicting overlapping authority, repeated transfer/activity/notice or false success.

**Inherited requirements (not reopened):** Original 5.21, completed eligibility/coverage,
5.24-A protected transfers, 5.23-A expiry/return, L-0146/0147/0156/0160, existing E3
worker/notification mechanics and current owner-specific authority. Manager confirms
availability beforehand; no appointee acceptance, new role, duplicate reassignment log
or general scheduling engine. External waits remain outside business locks by default.

return integration; current-source replacement and stale/duplicate/interrupted recovery.

### Story 5.22-D: End a temporary appointment early from its details

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-23. Not implementation-ready or finally sized.**

As an authorized Leave Manager,
I want to review and confirm ending an appointment early,
So that I understand where unfinished work will go and whether cover remains missing.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an applicable appointment and current management authority,
**When** viewing its existing details,
**Then** offer End early using completed 5.22-C current-state reads and show current
people, responsibilities and dates.

**Given** an early end is being prepared,
**When** reviewing actual unfinished approvals,
**Then** show their proposed eligible receiving approver or explain that unresolved work
will remain pending because cover is missing, and require a reason.
The action does not implicitly appoint or grant authority to a replacement.

**Given** current reviewed consequences,
**When** confirming,
**Then** require explicit confirmation of the early end and disclosed transfer-or-pending
result using the completed API, without making replacement availability a prerequisite
for ending temporary authority.

**Given** a confirmed early end,
**When** showing the result,
**Then** display the ended appointment and actual transferred versus still-pending work,
with continuing missing-cover attention even when no requests are waiting,
**And** provide existing authorized appointment/work navigation without implying completed
decisions or already approved leave were reversed.

**Given** stale input, unavailable verification, lost access or an uncertain confirmation,
**When** correcting input, recovering the session or choosing Retry,
**Then** preserve useful authorized context and resolve the original operation before
repeating a consequential action; show truthful current feedback.
A confirmed early end followed by failed detail refresh retries the read only, and
session recovery never automatically confirms termination.

**Given** desktop, mobile or keyboard use,
**When** reviewing, confirming or returning,
**Then** preserve accessible focus and useful navigation context with established loading/
empty/error behavior, using completed appointment/transfer flows for further cover actions.

5.22-C actual authority end/transfer-or-pending/coverage/current-source protection and

no new administrative draft, replacement permission, appointee acceptance or history engine.

### Story 5.25-A: Restore outstanding supervisor review when recorded absence ends

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-23. Not implementation-ready or finally sized.**

As an authorized approver,
I want pending fallback requests to reflect the supervisor's return,
So that current required approval steps govern unfinished work.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a real pending request using absence fallback and no completed final decision,
**When** the recorded absence ends,
**Then** actual recoverable owner processing rechecks current applicable policy, supervisor
eligibility/authority and request/step state and restores the required outstanding supervisor
step, respecting current permanent replacement and valid temporary cover.
Do not resurrect superseded original or temporary authority.

**Given** the recorded absence no longer permits fallback,
**When** an approval or finalization is attempted before return processing catches up,
**Then** actual current authority/required-step checks deny completion based on the ended
absence; delayed processing or unavailable verification does not preserve fallback permission.
Reconcile this guard with existing 5.4/5.18-A ownership once before first activation.

**Given** a valid fallback final decision already completed,
**When** the supervisor returns or return work retries,
**Then** preserve that completed outcome without reopening approval or requiring reapproval.

**Given** current eligibility/return verification is unavailable or no eligible supervisor
can take the restored step,
**When** return cannot fully resolve,
**Then** retain truthful recoverable pending work and authorized manager attention without
inventing eligibility, approving automatically or continuing ended-absence fallback.

**Given** a valid return transition,
**When** applying its protected local effects,
**Then** persist actual responsibility/required-step change, existing activity/audit, outcome
and required supervisor notification intent consistently and expose current queue/attention
results through existing reads and queue/detail/decision consumers.
Preserve valid decisions, independent conditions/funding and applicable waiting-clock rules.

**Given** recorded absence/source changes, concurrent decisions or duplicate/interrupted
return work,
**When** processing or recovering the real transition,
**Then** use current revision/order/fencing to preserve valid completed outcomes and newer
replacement/cover, without stale authority or repeated transition/activity/notice.
Prove the actual absence/source producer-to-return consumer integration before activation.

pending with optional existing comment and normal timers; no new Wait command/state or

worker/notification contracts. Temporary appointment expiry remains 5.23-A. Retain narrow
worker organization scope, durable version compatibility, initiator/executor evidence,

### Story 5.26-A: Generate recurring reminders for currently actionable approvals

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-23. Not implementation-ready or finally sized.**

As an assigned approver,
I want timely reminders for approval work that currently needs my action,
So that unanswered requests receive attention.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a currently actionable unanswered approval step,
**When** its configured reminder interval becomes due,
**Then** actual durable owner processing creates the current reminder occurrence and
required notification intent through existing E3 delivery, repeating at the configured
interval with a default of three calendar days.

**Given** later, already decided or policy-omitted steps or requests no longer awaiting action,
**When** discovering due work or checking relevance before handover,
**Then** exclude obsolete/non-actionable reminders and do not infer current eligibility
from unavailable verification. Leave owns this business check; shared delivery owns transport.

**Given** responsibility transfers or a supervisor step is restored,
**When** actual reminder processing evaluates the current step,
**Then** address the currently authorized responsible approver using applicable clock
rules, retaining the same unfinished step's original waiting clock across reassignment
and excluding former approvers from new outstanding-action handover.
A different step starts its clock when actionable; exact restoration/anchor contracts remain open.

**Given** waiting for supervisor return,
**When** reminders become due,
**Then** continue normal timing using the existing rule, without a new Wait state/control
or timer pause; reminders themselves do not alter business outcomes or assignments.

**Given** missed processing, concurrent claims, restart or interrupted generation,
**When** due work is recovered,
**Then** create at most one current catch-up reminder for outstanding approval work rather
than all missed occurrences, coordinate existing pending unhanded intent and retain outbox
records/identities without clearing/recreating them or producing duplicate occurrences.
Resume the normal schedule under the bound next-due contract.

**Given** actual decision, withdrawal, transfer, return or source changes,
**When** occurrence generation/recovery and handover race with the change,
**Then** use current step/recipient evidence and durable occurrence protection to avoid
obsolete new handover or repeated intent, retaining safe history of superseded unhanded
work. Already accepted or uncertain remote effects are not claimed locally recalled.

**Given** a reminder is delivered and opened,
**When** the recipient follows its existing minimal-content notification link,
**Then** recheck current access and show current authorized request state through existing
surfaces, preserving E3 privacy/read-state protections without changing approval, funding
or employee-response requirements.

retries/relevance handover/read state. 5.25 owns waiting/return semantics, not this timer.
No new notification transport, reminder screen or general scheduling engine. Use restricted
owner workers/per-item organization, compatible durable work, atomic occurrence/intent,
safe attribution and short local transactions without external waits.

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-23. Not implementation-ready or finally sized.**

As an authorized Leave Manager,

So that I can help resolve delays using my existing authority.

**Given** a currently required unanswered approval step,

required notification intent for a currently authorized manager under the bound recipient

transfer flow; standard Leave Manager has that permission by default and restricted custom

escalation, without repeated event/intent/history or clearing/recreating existing work.

**Given** decisions, withdrawal, transfer, source/return or access changes,
**When** generating escalation, reading attention or checking relevance before handover,
**Then** use current required-step, visibility and recipient evidence and suppress obsolete
new handover. Unavailable verification does not establish authority/relevance; retain
recoverable evidence. Accepted or uncertain remote effects are not claimed locally recalled.

than reimplementing them. A owns only remaining actual appointment/return/transfer/source
projection enrichment, current assignment/remedy action mapping and integration with
completed escalation/attention reads. Actual producers retain protected gap effects;
A does not become their first safety gate or another issue store.

As an authorized Leave Manager,
I want current missing approval cover available alongside other attention items,
So that I can arrange cover before approval work becomes stuck.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a known approval coverage gap from actual owning workflows,
**When** reading authorized Needs attention,
**Then** expose the affected approver, responsibilities, uncovered dates and any waiting
request references without waiting for the escalation threshold.
Apply current organization/request visibility and existing coverage/fallback rules.

**Given** valid cover becomes unavailable after leave was approved,
**When** composing current coverage attention,
**Then** expose Replacement approver needed even when no requests currently wait,
**And** preserve approved leave and completed decisions.

**Given** a coverage issue,
**When** reading its detail,
**Then** provide current gap, relevant existing assignments and permitted appointment/
reassignment action mapping using existing current capabilities and completed commands.
Do not automatically select/appoint a substitute, extend authority or grant permissions.

**Given** an authorized coverage exception,
**When** reading the issue,
**Then** expose its recorded explanation while keeping actual uncovered responsibilities
visible; an exception explanation does not falsely declare cover arranged.

**Given** actual absence, appointment, expiry/early-end, supervisor-return, membership or
source-supervisor changes,
**When** their current owner evidence and queue state refresh the projection,
**Then** update affected dates/work and clear the issue only with valid cover or the
original approver currently eligible and available, respecting replacement/cover precedence.
An empty queue or unavailable verification alone cannot clear a known gap.

**Given** interrupted refresh, repeated source observations or changed authorization,
**When** recovering or querying attention,
**Then** use stable scoped issue identity/current evidence to avoid duplicate or stale
resolved items, preserve recoverable known-gap evidence and return truthful unavailable
versus empty results without widening access.
Prove integration with actual source writers and real pending-work changes.

**Inherited requirements (not reopened):** Original 5.28 AC1–5; 5.2–5.5 eligibility/
coverage/fallback/exception and completed 5.21–5.25 appointment/transfer/end/return owners
retain their protected effects and minimum gap evidence. This slice composes those actual
facts with completed 5.27-A attention reads, not another coverage or reassignment engine.
Use applicable L-0065/0076–0079/0146/0147/0153/0160, existing privacy/current authority,
short local transactions and external owner HTTP boundaries. No new dismissal workflow,
substitute recommendation, history engine or permission grant.

**Traceability / planned verification:** Original 5.28 AC1–5 API portions mapped below;
Features §10/15/17 and Leave Manager attention UX. Observe failing acceptance before
implementation. Verify actual known-gap producers without escalation delay, scoped
responsibility/date/work references, post-approval lost cover and empty queue, assignment/
exception/current action detail, actual valid-cover/eligible-return clearing, unavailable
facts retaining known issues, current replacement precedence, real writer/queue refresh
and interrupted/repeated recovery. Reference owning rule/worker suites instead of repeating
product rules or generic notification tests. Exact paths/commands open; no runtime tests.

**Pre-story inputs / sizing:** Complete actual coverage-producing eligibility/absence,
appointment/expiry/end/return/transfer/source workflows and authorized 5.27-A attention
contracts before this integration. Bind positive source inventory and alternate writers,

### Story 5.31-A: Compose current leave and required responses on My Leave

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-23. Not implementation-ready or finally sized.**

As an employee,
I want My Leave to bring my current requests, upcoming leave and required actions together,
So that I can quickly understand what needs my attention.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** actual own pending requests and upcoming approved leave,
**When** opening existing My Leave,
**Then** extend earlier minimum result rows with current dates/concise status and put
requests requiring my response near the top, using actual current request/response sources.

**Given** a request in either section,
**When** selecting it,
**Then** open completed request details directly and provide the existing applicable
employee-response entry, preserving actual current action eligibility.
Do not introduce a new response gate or treat notification read state as acknowledgement.

**Given** a completed request action,
**When** returning to My Leave,
**Then** refresh affected request, response indicator and balance sections through their
actual owners while preserving useful page context/focus.
A confirmed action followed by failed refresh retries the read rather than the mutation.

**Given** one section is unavailable,
**When** other sections load,
**Then** keep successful sections usable and offer Retry for the failed section,
**And** show empty state or zero only from confirmed authoritative results, not failed loading.

**Given** existing Apply/resume-draft, balances/explanations or calendar/history entry,
**When** using My Leave,
**Then** retain completed existing surfaces/navigation and their current source checks.
Dashboard balance failure alone does not block Apply when its own authoritative checks succeed.

**Given** changed access, stale reads, session recovery or mobile/keyboard navigation,
**When** loading, retrying or returning,
**Then** recheck current own-organization visibility and preserve safe useful context with
existing accessibility/focus/session conventions; do not automatically repeat consequential actions.

### E6 preparation and single-review convention — 2026-10-23

At the user's request to avoid reading each scope twice and waiting for each generation,
prepare E6 draft stories, candidate delivery boundaries, dependency order, duplicate-scope
reconciliation and single-agent sizing assessment before the collaborative walkthrough.
Use existing feature/ADR/UX truth and current working tree. Keep drafts explicitly unapproved;
do not append them as approved replacement stories or mark workflow steps complete merely
because preparation finished. User direction adjusts the generic per-story generation
cadence; BMAD remains the sole workflow and authoritative product sources are not duplicated.

Then present a compact delivery map and guide the user through each consolidated story once,
focusing on new product decisions and material tradeoffs. Include boundary and sizing
implications in that same review; reference inherited safeguards instead of repeating them.
Prepare independent material while any genuinely blocking product question is pending.
If review changes a story, show its material delta rather than repeat the entire story;
revisit only affected contracts/size/order/coverage. Exact contracts, unresolved decisions,
coverage evidence and readiness remain visibly open until actually resolved. No speculative
size PASS, product approval, implementation permission or skipped epic completion gate.
This applies when E6 begins after E5's remaining planning is handled; do not start E6 now.

### Story 5.32-L: Verify original submission recovery after its response is lost

**Delivery boundary approved — 2026-10-23. Not implementation-ready or finally sized.**

As an employee submitting leave,
I want Retry to recover the actual original submission outcome,
So that an interrupted response does not cause duplicate leave or funding effects.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** completed actual 5.11-A/B submission/outcome interfaces and a controlled own request,
**When** submission commits but its response is lost before browser confirmation,
**Then** reproduce uncertainty at the real interface boundary while retaining actual owner
persistence/handlers, rather than substituting a fabricated success response.

**Given** that uncertain browser outcome,
**When** the employee chooses existing Retry,
**Then** verify it resolves the original operation first and returns the actual submitted
request/result without another request, reservation or repeated required intent.
No separate Check status screen or automatic new submission is introduced.

**Given** the recovered original outcome,
**When** independently inspecting real owner records and browser result,
**Then** compare request identity/count, reservation/accounting, draft finalization,
activity/notification intent and displayed current details against contracts.
Do not treat a single API projection as proof of all owner effects.

**Given** submission is confirmed but a subsequent detail refresh fails,
**When** Retry is used for that failed read,
**Then** verify it refreshes current authorized detail without replaying the confirmed mutation.

**Given** linked owning unresolved/known-failure/authorization/concurrent-command/delivery tests,
**When** recording results or a reproduced composition defect,
**Then** retain exact fixture/failure-injection/source/test/command/result ownership and
route fixes to their owner or explicitly sized integration work. This scenario is not
first proof of required idempotency, terminal guards or durable delivery.

accounting/history/notification contracts. Required owner recovery must already pass before
activation. No new business state, recovery workflow or implementation authorization.

observations. Reference owner suites for other failure/concurrency variants; add failing
