**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E7-15-AC01**

**Given** actual permitted source records and normalized query,
**When** the report executes,
**Then** one current request with its actual currently required pending-step details, preserved E5 waiting clocks, current assignees, response/gate blockers and no duplicate-step request totals.

**E7-15-AC02**

**Given** the permitted date/employee/type/department/location/supervisor-team selection,
**When** rows and totals are assembled,
**Then** the report’s declared date/grouping basis is applied before pagination and aggregation; arbitrary hidden filter identities are not an existence oracle.

**E7-15-AC03**

**Given** multiple event lines, request steps, repeated periods or changed grouping,
**When** results are calculated,
**Then** canonical report row/action identities avoid double counting, with integer minute/string counters and no incompatible day-unit grand total.

**E7-15-AC04**

**Given** unknown required inputs, wrong organization or unsupported query,
**When** the API responds,
**Then** safe typed unavailable/invalid/denied results replace neither errors with empty data nor current authority with historical membership.

### Story 7.19: Generate an audited CSV from all matching authorized report rows

As a authorized report exporter,
I want the same report query exported completely,
So that pagination does not omit matching rows.

**Status:** Approved E7 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Features §19/20; UX flow 12; P-0023/0025; PRIV-19.

**Internal predecessors:** 7.7, 7.9, 7.11, 7.13, 7.15, 7.17. Actual external owners are listed in the E7 review package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Bounded synchronous CSV endpoint over the six completed query/serializer adapters, scoped export audit and safe output; no export queue, object-store link or second snapshot service.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E7-19-AC01**

**Given** a current authorized report/export grant and exact normalized displayed query,
**When** Export CSV is requested,
**Then** all matching authorized rows across pages are generated from one bounded local read snapshot with the same filters/field rules and totals, not only visible rows.

**E7-19-AC02**

**Given** concurrent source changes, a hidden-type filter, cross-org identity or revoked access,
**When** generation starts or resumes,
**Then** current authorization/valid query are required, the result identifies its generation observation and source completeness, and no cursor or query digest grants access.

**E7-19-AC03**

**Given** formula-like employee labels, delimiters, quotes, Unicode or unexpected size/time limits,
**When** serialization runs,
**Then** fixed schema UTF-8 CSV quoting and text-cell formula neutralization preserve safe values; bounded failure sends no partial CSV as a successful export.

**E7-19-AC04**

**Given** mandatory export evidence cannot commit or the connection fails after release starts,
**When** delivery occurs,
**Then** no bytes are released before durable generated-export authorization evidence; evidence records generated/authorized release, not proof of a complete client download, and Retry may generate a newly audited current export.

**E7-20-AC02**

### Story 7.21: Read Identity/Access audit evidence through its owner

As a authorized audit investigator,
I want permitted Identity/Access evidence,
So that the Leave audit view does not read another owner’s tables.

**Status:** Approved E7 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Features §20; P-0023/0025/0056; E1 audit ownership.

**Internal predecessors:** None. Actual external owners are listed in the E7 review package.

**Single-agent boundary:** One bounded owner-local read projection plus its Leave HTTP adapter over existing services/access actor/member/grant/organization event infrastructure and E1/E2 owner contracts; no event rewriting, credential widening or common audit-write service.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E7-21-AC01**

**Given** the owning service holds required immutable evidence,
**When** its explicit scoped read projection is invoked,
**Then** only verified membership/application-admission/grant/role transitions relevant to Leave are returned with owner/event identity, recorded UTC time, actor/initiator/executor, operation/resource and allowed transition/reason fields.

**E7-21-AC02**

**Given** current actor/audit context and Leave application/organization scope,
**When** the owner authorizes the request,
**Then** service identity and exact on-behalf read policy are independently enforced; a generic Leave service key cannot enumerate unrelated apps/accounts/organizations.

**E7-21-AC03**

**Given** paged evidence or a linked event is requested,
**When** the owner returns it,
**Then** stable upper-bound/window/order/cursor and versioned allowlisted fields preserve immutable provenance; wrong-scope IDs do not disclose metadata.

**E7-21-AC04**

**Given** owner outage, unavailable source retention or missing required historical evidence,
**When** the adapter responds,
**Then** availability/coverage limits are explicit and never an empty-complete audit result; diagnostics and payload dumps do not replace business audit.

planning baseline and both ADR-0169 reporting choices are accepted. Earlier
proposed/awaiting-review passages are historical. Next is E8 preparation; E5 stays

## E8 — Reconcile pilot data and operate Leave recoverably

**Prepared 2026-10-25; proposed for one complete-package review.** The user accepted
E7 and directed next. E5 stays closed, E6 ADR-0168 and E7 ADR-0169 remain Accepted.
This is the last epic's step-03 planning package, not whole-product coverage/readiness
PASS or permission for actual imports, migrations, grants, provider changes or activation.

See [E8 review/size/dependencies](e8-planning-review.md), [coverage allocation](e8-coverage-audit.md)
and the [owning import/qualification contract](../../apps/leave/docs/architecture/contracts/e8-import-cutover-and-qualification.md).
Proposed ADR-0170 collects import pending-work/notification choices. All ordinary
first-consumer security, migrations, audit and operational protections remain with
earlier owners; E8 composes their actual evidence rather than adding them late.

The 30 candidates cover import and cutover (8.1–14), cross-cutting qualification
(8.15–20), recovery/release/performance (8.21–25), UAT/support/evidence (8.26–28)
and scoped pilot activation/verification (8.29–30). Import commands use current
verified authority, full source/revision/guard checks, immutable attribution/evidence
and original-operation recovery. Each item owns its focused actual-role/HTTP/native
or browser evidence and all five impacts; later qualification does not defer safety.
No live test or customer email is authorized by preparation.

### Story 8.1: Validate a versioned consultant import package without business writes

As a authorized migration consultant,
I want documented templates and an exact batch identity,
So that source mistakes are caught before anything is applied.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Features MVP exclusions; migration runbook Validate/review/apply; BIZ-35.

**Internal predecessors:** None. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Offline CLI/input-schema and manifest validation with source-file hashes, canonical identifiers and safe row diagnostics; no server import/state mutation.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-01-AC01**

**Given** documented template version, explicit target org/source namespace and source files,
**When** I validate the package,
**Then** a canonical batch ID/digest binds original files, source record IDs, intended records and balance-date/unit conventions.

**E8-01-AC02**

**Given** unknown columns, duplicate source keys, invalid dates/units or malformed files,
**When** validation executes,
**Then** blocking employee/source-row errors are precise and bounded without logging private source payloads.

**E8-01-AC03**

**Given** source content changes under the same batch ID,
**When** validation or resume runs,
**Then** digest mismatch rejects reuse; a revised package/report is required rather than treating changed input as a retry.

**E8-01-AC04**

**Given** validation alone or a wrong/inferred target,
**When** the tool runs,
**Then** no business write, role/account creation, notification or ad hoc database operation occurs and target scope is explicit.

### Story 8.2: Resolve import identities and owner prerequisites explicitly

As a authorized migration consultant,
I want verified source-to-person/employment/configuration mappings,
So that imports do not create duplicate people or grant access.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Features §2 and MVP import scope; P-0040/0042/0056/0058; E1/E2 owners.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.1. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Read-only cross-owner preflight/mapping references through existing authorized Identity/Access/People/Leave contracts; no duplicate employee master.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-02-AC01**

**Given** a source employee or historical actor reference,
**When** the preflight resolves mappings,
**Then** verified enduring employment/person/type/policy/schedule/calendar and source actor evidence are used; same email or name alone cannot link identity.

**E8-02-AC02**

**Given** accountless employees, leavers/rehire or unknown legacy decision actors,
**When** mapping executes,
**Then** employment history remains one enduring relationship; external provenance is retained without synthetic Auth accounts, invented actors or effective grants.

**E8-02-AC03**

**Given** missing People/configuration/permission/document prerequisite,
**When** preflight runs,
**Then** the exact owning setup action is reported and application stays blocked for affected units; approved E2/manual provisioning stays the owner.

**E8-02-AC04**

**Given** wrong organization, stale mapping/revision or unavailable current authority,
**When** verification executes,
**Then** it fails safely instead of inferring access from employment, consultant title, historical data or an existing source identifier.

### Story 8.3: Reconcile opening balances and transferred request effects in preview

As a authorized migration consultant,
I want a source-to-result balance preview,
So that future bookings and reservations are counted exactly once.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Migration runbook balance convention examples; Features §6; E3 provenance; BIZ-35.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.1, 8.2. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Pure import normalization/reconciliation adapter over actual E3 replay and source portions, with before-request versus net-source conventions and supported history boundary.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-03-AC01**

**Given** source shows 8 days and 2 future approved days,
**When** its convention is declared and normalized,
**Then** the preview yields 6 available if 8 is before those bookings, or 8 if already net, preserving actual units and every included effect once.

**E8-03-AC02**

**Given** opening portions, automatic earning, expiry/cap or prior source requests interact,
**When** the plan is calculated,
**Then** original period/validity and source provenance reconcile with E3; imported history reflected in baseline is not deducted again or represented as a fresh allowance.

**E8-03-AC03**

**Given** insufficient source facts for historical/cancellation replay or ambiguous source meaning,
**When** preview executes,
**Then** the affected coverage/operation is explicitly unsupported or blocked pending source resolution, never silently reconstructed from one total.

**E8-03-AC04**

**Given** preview/repeated evaluation,
**When** the normalized plan is inspected,
**Then** no event/reservation/decision/snapshot is written and all row/employee/source differences and required current approval/notification consequences are in the report.

### Story 8.4: Bind client email approval to the exact import preview

As a authorized migration consultant,
I want a reviewable reconciliation report and retained exact-batch approval evidence,
So that only the approved package can be applied.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Features MVP exclusions; migration runbook steps 2–5; UX flow 15.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.3. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Consultant report/evidence artifact plus minimal immutable server manifest registration for later protected apply; no email sending, client login or confirmation screen.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-04-AC01**

**Given** a complete validated normalized plan,
**When** the report is generated,
**Then** batch/source/plan/report digests, target org, balance date, row/employee results, unsupported scope and exact apply selection are reviewable.

**E8-04-AC02**

**Given** an authorized client contact approves by email,
**When** the consultant records evidence,
**Then** contact/authority basis, approval reference/hash, exact approved digests and responsible operator are retained with restricted access; the record is not an app grant.

**E8-04-AC03**

**Given** data, mappings, material plan, apply selection or cutover delta changes,
**When** application is requested,
**Then** approval no longer matches and a revised report with renewed client email approval is required.

**E8-04-AC04**

**Given** approval evidence is missing or record persistence fails,
**When** apply is attempted,
**Then** it is blocked; no in-app Awaiting client confirmation, Confirm balances action, automatic correspondence or guessed approval is introduced.

### Story 8.5: Apply reconciled opening portions through the accounting owner

As a authorized import executor,
I want an import adapter in the existing Leave accounting transaction,
So that opening amounts remain auditable and replay-safe.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Features §6; migration runbook; E3 immutable event/portion contract.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.3, 8.4. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** E3-owned internal opening/reconciliation adapter, staged-source economic-read eligibility and scoped source-key/effect constraints, only inside the actual employee import envelope.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-05-AC01**

**Given** an exact approved employee plan and current authorized transaction,
**When** the internal adapter executes,
**Then** only declared opening/economic source portions and attribution are added with original period/expiry, imported-baseline provenance and E3 stable ordering.

**E8-05-AC02**

**Given** a source balance already includes selected reservation/consumption,
**When** normalization is applied,
**Then** the matching imported request effects are represented once, conserving approved available/remaining/reserved amounts without double-counted earning.

**E8-05-AC03**

**Given** same source key/causal effect is retried or changed input uses it,
**When** the adapter executes,
**Then** matching replay returns existing outcome and incompatible input conflicts; old events/evidence are immutable.

**E8-05-AC04**

**Given** a local stage fails or runtime attempts DDL/cross-org mutation,
**When** the actual transaction runs,
**Then** the entire local employee unit rolls back with real runtime permission/structural constraint protection.

### Story 8.6: Adopt recorded historical and approved requests with explicit provenance

As a authorized import executor,
I want a narrow recorded-request adoption adapter,
So that transferred records retain their evidence without counterfeit approvals.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Features §11/MVP import scope; P-0025/0056; E5/E6 history contracts.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.2, 8.4, 8.5. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** E5-owned internal settled-request import branch, staged-source read eligibility and source mapping, including historical/approved/closed source records and reconciled accounting links; no ordinary approval bypass endpoint.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-06-AC01**

**Given** an approved recorded source outcome and exact mapped request,
**When** adoption occurs inside the employee unit,
**Then** actual source dates/status/duration/decisions are retained as external provenance, with the migration executor distinct from original decision attribution.

**E8-06-AC02**

**Given** a legacy actor or decision is not verifiably linked to a registry actor,
**When** the record is adopted,
**Then** external source identity/label remains explicitly unverified evidence; no fabricated person, human signature or login is created.

**E8-06-AC03**

**Given** a historical record is already reflected in opening baseline or future approved consumption,
**When** economic links are created,
**Then** the exact source-convention mapping counts effects once and preserves enough basis for supported E6 reversal/history; missing basis cannot be hidden by a fake grant.

**E8-06-AC04**

**Given** a source record is imported twice, conflicts with existing leave or has no approved evidence,
**When** the adapter runs,
**Then** source-key/employee/date/current guards reject incompatible adoption and no standard Approver/default grant is inferred.

### Story 8.7: Import pending requests into a freshly verified approval cycle

As a authorized import executor,
I want an explicitly reviewed current pending workflow,
So that old-system decisions cannot silently authorize new Leave work.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Migration runbook pending transfer; E5 submission/response/current route; proposed L-0170.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.2, 8.4, 8.5, 8.6. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** E5-owned internal pending-request import adapter over actual request/reservation/route/response interfaces, with explicit approved mapping and activation-held current notices.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-07-AC01**

**Given** pending source leave is selected and its new current route is in the approved report,
**When** the adapter applies it,
**Then** under proposed ADR-0170 a fresh Leave cycle/reservation is created from current rules/authority; prior external steps remain historical evidence, not binding local decisions.

**E8-07-AC02**

**Given** initial unpaid response, required documents, date/capacity, current route or funding are unresolved,
**When** application is evaluated,
**Then** ordinary E5 gates remain truthful and no proxy acknowledgement, approval, source-role grant or silently rerouted work is fabricated.

**E8-07-AC03**

**Given** source history and new current workflow have different waiting context,
**When** the result is recorded,
**Then** original submission/wait evidence stays separate while new actionable clocks use disclosed actual activation/cycle facts under ADR-0170.

**E8-07-AC04**

**Given** retry, stale source plan or rollback,
**When** the producer executes,
**Then** one request/cycle/reservation and held notice intent correspond to the source key; no partial unit or historical notification replay escapes.

### Story 8.8: Prepare imported documents through the existing Content owner

As a authorized migration consultant,
I want verified reusable content and protected staged associations,
So that documents cannot bypass privacy or cleanup safeguards.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Features §12; E4 association/private-read/fixed-byte owners; P-0030/0054/0055.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.2, 8.4. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Bounded consultant source-byte ingest/target adapter through actual E4/Content APIs and existing pending-association lifecycle; no provider direct write or new content pipeline.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-08-AC01**

**Given** an approved source document with scoped request mapping,
**When** preparation uses actual Content control/byte APIs,
**Then** exact byte identity/type/size/checksum/readiness and Leave application ownership are verified before association.

**E8-08-AC02**

**Given** prepared bytes await an employee unit or apply fails,
**When** association/cleanup runs,
**Then** pending import confirmation is protected by the existing E4 handshake; retries reuse identity and finalized bytes, never infer abandonment from another owner’s status.

**E8-08-AC03**

**Given** document metadata, private read or cross-organization target is requested,
**When** the actual consumer authorizes it,
**Then** current Leave/domain plus separate sensitive access and Content ownership apply; no browser bearer private read URL or metadata leak.

**E8-08-AC04**

**Given** source bytes are missing, changed, unverified or unavailable,
**When** preflight/apply runs,
**Then** affected required-document units are blocked/truthfully held and no scanner/OCR pipeline is added as an MVP prerequisite.

### Story 8.9: Apply one approved employee import atomically through Leave

As a authorized import executor,
I want a bounded employee apply command and consultant CLI,
So that opening balances and matching requests cannot be half-applied.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Migration runbook apply/retry/audit; P-0012/0013/0020/0022/0035.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.4, 8.5, 8.6, 8.7, 8.8. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** One actual app-owned import command/CLI composition with minimal unit manifest/outcomes, existing guards and internal 8.5–7 adapters; not HTTP calls to separate local commits.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-09-AC01**

**Given** the exact approved manifest/employee unit and ready owner inputs,
**When** apply is explicitly requested,
**Then** one Leave transaction commits all employee/type openings, transferred requests/links/reservations, association confirmations, evidence/audit/outcome and held intent together.

**E8-09-AC02**

**Given** another employee is invalid or fails,
**When** units are applied,
**Then** successful employee units remain recorded; each failing employee has a truthful independent result, no whole-batch atomicity or cross-owner rollback is claimed.

**E8-09-AC03**

**Given** policy/source/reference membership, current authorization or daily capacity changed since report,
**When** protected execution starts,
**Then** complete fresh guards/sets and expected revisions are checked, material mismatch blocks without silently editing the approved plan.

**E8-09-AC04**

**Given** Content/People preparation or network calls are needed,
**When** execution is composed,
**Then** external owner waits stay outside business locks; prepared owner outcomes are separately truthful and no DB/schema/grant/provider side effect is smuggled into import.

### Story 8.10: Resume imports using original employee operation outcomes

As a authorized migration consultant,
I want status and safe retry after interruption,
So that successful rows are not imported again.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Migration runbook duplicate prevention; E1/E5 operation recovery; P-0012.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.9. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** CLI status/resume plus existing owner receipt extension for batch/employee targets and source uniqueness; no workflow engine or autonomous retry daemon.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-10-AC01**

**Given** a connection drops after an employee commit,
**When** status/resume is requested,
**Then** the original actor/org/batch/unit operation resolves before retry and matching committed effects are not repeated.

**E8-10-AC02**

**Given** a batch partly succeeded or an owner source remains uncertain,
**When** the report is read,
**Then** committed, known-uncommitted and unresolved unit/owner outcomes are distinct, with safe explicit resume and no claim all succeeded.

**E8-10-AC03**

**Given** changed source data or a different actor/organization reuses an operation,
**When** execution is attempted,
**Then** canonical fingerprint/current scope rules deny mismatch; source-key uniqueness also protects against a fresh operation duplicating the same record.

**E8-10-AC04**

**Given** a newer independent legitimate correction changed the imported record,
**When** an old import retry arrives,
**Then** it cannot overwrite current data, reactivate a closed lifecycle or reinterpret a historical receipt as current record state.

### Story 8.11: Reconcile applied records against the exact approved batch

As a authorized migration consultant,
I want an actual post-apply comparison,
So that discrepancies are visible before handover.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Migration runbook step 6/cutover; E7 report definitions; BIZ-35.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.10. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Read-only actual-state reconciliation report over imported maps, E3 balances and E5/E6/E7 records; no mutation to make expectations pass.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-11-AC01**

**Given** all selected units have actual outcomes,
**When** post-apply verification runs,
**Then** source IDs, request states/counts, approved normalized portions/available/reserved amounts, documents and actor evidence reconcile with the approved report.

**E8-11-AC02**

**Given** source net/gross convention or imported history would double count,
**When** the verification compares,
**Then** the 8/2→6 versus 8/2→8 oracle and each actual source case detect the mismatch rather than adjusting the expected result.

**E8-11-AC03**

**Given** some units/associations/current inputs are unresolved,
**When** verification completes,
**Then** incomplete and mismatch are explicit and block authoritative handover for affected scope.

**E8-11-AC04**

**Given** an approved correction is needed,
**When** resolution is chosen,
**Then** it uses a revised reviewed/import or existing E6/adjustment owner command, preserving prior evidence rather than editing history or automatically deleting applied data.

### Story 8.12: Reconcile export-to-cutover changes before final approval

As a responsible consultant and client contact,
I want a documented freeze and delta reconciliation,
So that the old system cannot drift after approval.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Migration runbook Cutover checklist; UX flow 15.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.11. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Consultant cutover/delta artifact and exact revised-batch comparison through existing preview/approval flow; no client application page.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-12-AC01**

**Given** source export time differs from agreed balance/cutover date,
**When** handover is prepared,
**Then** responsible operator/contact, old-system write cutoff and intended Leave authority time are explicit.

**E8-12-AC02**

**Given** requests/decisions/cancellations/employment/adjustments changed after export,
**When** delta reconciliation runs,
**Then** all material changes appear in a revised exact preview/report with renewed client email approval before apply/activation.

**E8-12-AC03**

**Given** an unapproved delta or unresolved source-system activity remains,
**When** handover is attempted,
**Then** it is blocked or explicitly deferred; no presumed freeze or unchanged batch approval is claimed.

**E8-12-AC04**

**Given** client/contact approval is recorded,
**When** the normal application is inspected,
**Then** no Awaiting client confirmation checklist state, opening-balance assumption or automatic email workflow appears.

### Story 8.13: Release only current actionable imported-work notifications at activation

As a authorized activation operator,
I want controlled transition of imported current work,
So that employees do not receive a replay of old-system history.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Features §13; E3 outbox/receiver; E5 clocks; proposed L-0170.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.7, 8.10, 8.12. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Narrow import intent/activation-generation integration with existing outbox/clock/source owners; no second transport or universal notification pause.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-13-AC01**

**Given** concluded historical source records were adopted,
**When** notification intent is evaluated,
**Then** under proposed ADR-0170 no historic approval/rejection/cancellation/adjustment notice is replayed merely because it was imported.

**E8-13-AC02**

**Given** pending imported work is ready for reviewed activation,
**When** its activation generation is committed,
**Then** only actual current initial-response/approval actions produce existing versioned/deduplicated notices and real waiting-clock anchors, with current authority checks.

**E8-13-AC03**

**Given** activation repeats, access changes, work resolves or delivery is uncertain,
**When** release/retry executes,
**Then** existing relevance/causal identity/receiver dedup protect once-only action handover; old historical intent cannot reopen or notify a closed cycle.

**E8-13-AC04**

**Given** a specific import is not yet authorized or delivery provider fails,
**When** other work runs,
**Then** unreleased import intent remains durable without suppressing unrelated legitimate Leave notifications or undoing business commits.

### Story 8.14: Verify import arithmetic, atomic apply and interruption recovery

As a migration qualification owner,
I want actual-boundary proof before client data is used,
So that imports are not qualified by preview-only mocks.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** BIZ-35; migration runbook; P-0035; proposed L-0170.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.11, 8.12, 8.13. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Bounded disposable actual-API/native/Content import journey using representative source fixtures and adversarial repeats; actual adapters own their focused tests.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-14-AC01**

**Given** representative gross/net balances, historical/future approved/pending/corrected records and documents,
**When** the actual CLI/API import is exercised,
**Then** exact approved reconciliation matches real records and E3 source provenance with no double effects.

**E8-14-AC02**

**Given** crash after each local stage, duplicate source, response loss or concurrent change,
**When** recovery tests run,
**Then** per-employee rollback, independent committed units and original outcome recovery hold under restricted runtime roles.

**E8-14-AC03**

**Given** an old decision actor, route or initial employee response cannot be verified,
**When** import is exercised,
**Then** proposed migration policy stays explicit and no synthetic actor/approval/acknowledgement or permission is created.

**E8-14-AC04**

**Given** changed delta after approval or insufficient historical replay basis,
**When** qualification runs,
**Then** it is blocked/reapproved as specified and no expectation is changed to hide an unexplained mismatch.

### Story 8.15: Qualify cross-organization security through real owner boundaries

As a security reviewer,
I want representative role and alternate-path threat evidence,
So that API, job, file and export scope hold together.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Features NFRs/MVP acceptance; P-0018/0019/0026; L-0011–0017.

**Internal predecessors:** None. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Cross-epic threat-model and focused integrated native/API/HTTP abuse evidence, referencing completed owner suites rather than adding first protections late.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-15-AC01**

**Given** two organizations, ordinary/custom/temporary/admin/service roles and scoped fixtures,
**When** direct API/worker/file/export/audit paths are challenged,
**Then** tenant/owner/current action and sensitive-field boundaries hold independently of frontend hiding.

**E8-15-AC02**

**Given** pooled contexts, source mutations, revoked grants, cursor/ID spoofing and delayed work,
**When** the focused cases execute,
**Then** no prior-user/org authority or stale permission crosses the current protected boundary.

**E8-15-AC03**

**Given** logs, trace fields, errors or import artifacts contain canary sensitive input,
**When** the release artifacts are inspected,
**Then** tokens/private bytes/notes/full URLs/raw payloads are absent from diagnostics and public builds.

**E8-15-AC04**

**Given** a vulnerability or unavailable native proof is found,
**When** review completes,
**Then** the finding remains an explicit release blocker with owner/remediation/evidence; a mocked controller check cannot certify DB/file authorization.

### Story 8.16: Verify configured retention and auditable document disposal

As a privacy and Content owners,
I want actual retention/association safeguards and reviewed settings,
So that cleanup cannot destroy required or still-associated evidence.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** Features §12/NFRs; E4 retention/cleanup owners; P-0030/0054/0055.

**Internal predecessors:** None. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Focused existing Leave retention form/Content disposal qualification and per-client review record; no new legal rule or blanket purge.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-16-AC01**

**Given** the accepted default and organization-specific reviewed retention configuration,
**When** settings are reviewed,
**Then** two years after request closure is only the initial configurable medical default; actual authorized override/retention applicability and existing-file impact are recorded.

**E8-16-AC02**

**Given** saved draft, pending association/import, retained request or in-flight confirmation exists,
**When** cleanup is exercised,
**Then** existing lifecycle/association protection prevents premature disposal and settings Save alone does not delete bytes.

**E8-16-AC03**

**Given** a permitted disposal is due,
**When** actual controlled owner cleanup runs in isolated tests,
**Then** authorized auditable byte/reference treatment and supported retries remain consistent while required immutable decision/audit evidence survives.

**E8-16-AC04**

**Given** jurisdiction/client settings or provider disposal evidence are unresolved,
**When** release review runs,
**Then** the unresolved concrete configuration/owner evidence stays open; no legal compliance or provider guarantee is inferred from the default.

### Story 8.18: Demonstrate bounded worker drain, forced stop and recovery

As a worker and deployment owner,
I want verified shutdown/restart outcomes,
So that processing does not lose or duplicate effects.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** P-0024/0026/0027/0028; E3/E5 worker contracts.

**Internal predecessors:** None. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Actual first-owner worker/supervisor failure/restart composition with completed claims/leases/timeouts and truthful recovery report.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-18-AC01**

**Given** an actual worker receives shutdown,
**When** the configured drain runs,
**Then** it stops claims, respects the existing 30-second grace/bounded attempts and preserves stable work/receiver identities.

**E8-18-AC02**

**Given** grace expires or process dies after remote acceptance,
**When** the supervisor replaces it,
**Then** forced termination is recorded even without final worker log and abandoned work is fenced/recoverable without duplicate effects.

**E8-18-AC03**

**Given** new instance is healthy with eligible work or an empty queue,
**When** progress is observed,
**Then** verified resumed processing versus healthy idle versus unconfirmed recovery are distinct and old warnings remain.

**E8-18-AC04**

**Given** old payload versions, stale claims or repeated forced stops,
**When** the scenario executes,
**Then** supported work remains interpretable, stale completion is denied and repeated failure reaches the existing technical alert owner.

So that a real failure can be investigated without sensitive payloads.

### Story 8.20: Demonstrate alert thresholds and verified incident recovery

As a technical operations owner,
I want controlled evidence that real alerts route correctly,
So that outages and stale backups are actionable.

**Status:** Approved E8 planning baseline by user on 2026-10-25.

**Sources:** L-0120/0119; P-0037; platform observability direction.

**Internal predecessors:** 8.18, 8.19. Actual external predecessors are recorded in the E8 package.

**Single-agent boundary:** Actual probe/routing/incident threshold and recovery qualification over completed owner signals; no messages sent in this planning task.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**E8-20-AC01**

**Given** API unavailable or heartbeat missing,
**When** five consecutive minutes elapse in the test clock,
**Then** the technical incident opens/routs as configured, including worker heartbeat when no jobs exist.

**E8-20-AC02**

**Given** notification work is due and retries continue,
**When** age crosses fifteen minutes then one hour,
**Then** one incident warns/escalates without reset by retry backoff, distinguishing producer handover from downstream delivery.

**E8-20-AC03**

**Given** last verified usable recovery point exceeds one hour or confirmed integrity fails,
**When** the signal is tested,
**Then** immediate alert occurs; missing backup evidence is unknown/unhealthy rather than verified healthy.

**E8-20-AC04**

**Given** failures repeat or recovery is observed,
**When** incident handling runs,
**Then** signals are grouped and closed only after verified recovery; technical alert routing is independent of the failing business notification service and no staffed 24-hour SLA is claimed.

These six candidate children make the already-agreed shared/Leave allocation executable.

### Candidate Story 4.4-S: Protect a prepared attachment reference in Content

**Status:** Technical boundary candidate for consolidated planning review. Owner: Content.
**Predecessors:** 4.2, 4.3. Original parent criteria remain binding as allocated below.

As an authorized application service,
I want to prepare, confirm and reconcile one scoped Content reference,
So that a completed upload survives uncertain application association without becoming an indefinite orphan.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a verified ready object and an authenticated registered application caller,
**When** the caller prepares a reference using its already-durable association operation,
**Then** Content verifies exact stored owner/scope, binds the immutable content and association operation, and returns the same reference for matching retries; changed input is rejected.

**Given** a prepared reference or a committed application association,
**When** cleanup or disposal competes with it,
**Then** Content fences physical reclamation and cannot infer abandonment from elapsed time or the absence of an application table row in its own database.

**Given** a matching committed owner outcome,
**When** confirmation is delivered or recovered,
**Then** Content idempotently confirms the same reference; response loss cannot allocate a second identity or replace verified bytes.

**Given** the fixed preparation deadline has elapsed,
**When** bounded recovery reconciles the operation,
**Then** the owning application atomically resolves committed association versus terminal non-commit before Content confirms or releases protection; retries cannot renew the original deadline.

**Given** an unavailable owner or ambiguous outcome,
**When** reconciliation cannot finish,
**Then** protection enters monitored recovery with bounded attempts and escalation, and no automatic deletion or late confirmation against released/reclaimed identity occurs.

**Traceability / planned verification and size:** 4.4/AC03–07 and the Content side of AC08; AC05 is a cross-owner race obligation also exercised by 4.4-L. One shared reference state machine and recovery adapter, using completed worker/operation/owner foundations. No Leave table, upload verifier, provider deletion implementation or application editor.
Acceptance requires actual scoped API/database contract and race/crash/retry evidence;
shared children prove with a restricted fixture caller, Leave children with real draft
state. Required delivery ATDD/TDD precedes implementation. No runtime proof is claimed.

**Impacts:** Scaffold: prove/promote only the neutral client/worker/fixture delta with
the first owner; keep generated adapters synchronized. Shared UI: reuse existing accurate
attachment states, with no employee-facing lease/cleanup controls. Agent context: current
owner/HTTP/privacy/lifecycle instructions suffice. Documentation: owning protocol, source
allocation, recovery evidence and runbook. ADR: accepted decisions unchanged; unresolved
provider capability needs compatible proof or a linked superseding decision.

### Candidate Story 4.4-L: Confirm and recover a Leave draft attachment

**Status:** Technical boundary candidate for consolidated planning review. Owner: Leave API/persistence.
**Predecessors:** 4.4-S, E1-D2-A. Original parent criteria remain binding as allocated below.

As an employee,
I want to confirm a verified upload on my editable draft and recover its original outcome,
So that I can reopen my attachment without another upload.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an editable owned draft and ready scoped content,
**When** confirmation is prepared,
**Then** Leave checks current access/document authority, draft revision/lifecycle and policy allowance, then commits its pending association operation before asking Content for protection; external calls hold no business write lock.

**Given** a prepared protected reference and current local inputs,
**When** Leave commits the association,
**Then** verified type/per-file/aggregate limits are checked together under the draft write guard; association, revision, compact outcome and required confirmation intent commit atomically.

**Given** an uncertain response or association failure after upload,
**When** the same operation is retried,
**Then** Leave resolves its saved outcome and reuses the same content/reference without duplicate association or another upload; confirmed means the local association actually committed.

**Given** cleanup, recovery, basic Remove, discard or a stale confirm races with association,
**When** the local operation is resolved under the same draft/operation guard,
**Then** one committed association or terminal non-commit wins; discarded/closed/newer drafts cannot be resurrected and release follows an atomic local removal with recoverable intent.

**Given** a saved attachment and a reopened draft,
**When** the employee reads it under current authorization,
**Then** the confirmed association is available, or an honest permanently-missing/disposed outcome is returned; Content pending confirmation is reconciled without hiding a committed saved association.

**Traceability / planned verification and size:** 4.4/AC01–04, AC08–09 and Leave side of AC05–07. One draft-association command/read/outcome/recovery adapter, reusing Content reference machinery and E1 revision/lifecycle/operation support. Basic Remove/release belongs here so saved references can be released before later replacement UX; 4.8 adds replacement, not the first release API. No upload widget, generic worker or E5 submission.
Acceptance requires actual scoped API/database contract and race/crash/retry evidence;
shared children prove with a restricted fixture caller, Leave children with real draft
state. Required delivery ATDD/TDD precedes implementation. No runtime proof is claimed.

**Impacts:** Scaffold: prove/promote only the neutral client/worker/fixture delta with
the first owner; keep generated adapters synchronized. Shared UI: reuse existing accurate
attachment states, with no employee-facing lease/cleanup controls. Agent context: current
owner/HTTP/privacy/lifecycle instructions suffice. Documentation: owning protocol, source
allocation, recovery evidence and runbook. ADR: accepted decisions unchanged; unresolved
provider capability needs compatible proof or a linked superseding decision.

### Candidate Story 4.11-S: Dispose eligible unreferenced Content recoverably

**Status:** Technical boundary candidate for consolidated planning review. Owner: Content.
**Predecessors:** 4.4-S, 4.3. Original parent criteria remain binding as allocated below.

As the Content operator,
I want to dispose an eligible unreferenced object with a recoverable provider outcome,
So that sensitive bytes are reclaimed without deleting an active association.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an authorized scoped release and no legitimate reference or pending protection,
**When** disposal is claimed,
**Then** Content atomically fences new association/renewal against the same content lifecycle before making any provider call.

**Given** a saved reference or unresolved temporary reference,
**When** disposal is requested,
**Then** Content refuses disposal and invokes the existing bounded reconciliation path where appropriate; caller age or an app retention date cannot override reference protection.

**Given** a fenced disposal and provider success,
**When** completion is recorded,
**Then** Content preserves minimal attribution/disposal evidence, makes reads accurately unavailable and permanently prevents the identity resolving to replacement bytes.

**Given** provider timeout, crash, retry or uncertain deletion,
**When** recovery runs,
**Then** the same durable disposal is inspected/retried without holding database locks over provider waits, falsely claiming deletion, or blocking unrelated eligible objects.

**Given** an old backup, delayed association, provider version or failed operation is encountered,
**When** restore/recovery or subsequent read occurs,
**Then** tombstone and reference guards prevent readable resurrection, and operational evidence distinguishes active-object disposal from later backup expiry.

**Traceability / planned verification and size:** 4.11/AC02–06 plus the Content half of AC01 and AC07. One disposal/fence/provider adapter and restricted worker extension; reuse 4.4-S references, completed provider sealing/adoption and existing worker fixtures. Does not decide Leave retention, build a backup system or implement a second cleanup engine.
Acceptance requires actual scoped API/database contract and race/crash/retry evidence;
shared children prove with a restricted fixture caller, Leave children with real draft
state. Required delivery ATDD/TDD precedes implementation. No runtime proof is claimed.

**Impacts:** Scaffold: prove/promote only the neutral client/worker/fixture delta with
the first owner; keep generated adapters synchronized. Shared UI: reuse existing accurate
attachment states, with no employee-facing lease/cleanup controls. Agent context: current
owner/HTTP/privacy/lifecycle instructions suffice. Documentation: owning protocol, source
allocation, recovery evidence and runbook. ADR: accepted decisions unchanged; unresolved
provider capability needs compatible proof or a linked superseding decision.

### Candidate Story 4.11-L: Release Leave documents at their applicable retention boundary

**Status:** Technical boundary candidate for consolidated planning review. Owner: Leave.
**Predecessors:** 4.10, 4.11-S. Original parent criteria remain binding as allocated below.

As an organization responsible for sensitive documents,
I want to release only documents whose request lifecycle and retention permit disposal,
So that documents remain available while needed and disposition is auditable.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a document with known request lifecycle and applicable retention settings,
**When** Leave evaluates disposal eligibility,
**Then** the owner binds the closure/date/settings version and verifies no draft, active workflow or other legitimate protection; unknown closure/applicability is unresolved rather than permission to delete.

**Given** a retained association and a competing workflow change or renewed protection,
**When** release is committed,
**Then** Leave atomically rechecks domain eligibility and association state, records the release and outbound Content intent, then delivers it outside business locks.

**Given** uncertain release, provider delay or Content denial,
**When** recovery executes,
**Then** the same operation is resolved, legitimate protection is preserved, and delayed physical disposal is not reported as already complete.

**Given** authorized history access after release or disposal,
**When** document information is requested,
**Then** the API/UI accurately distinguishes pending disposal, disposed and temporarily unavailable outcomes without disclosing restricted filenames/content or changing request/approval evidence.

**Traceability / planned verification and size:** Leave half of 4.11/AC01–03 and AC05–07. One domain eligibility/release adapter and accurate existing document feedback, after 4.10 settings. Reuses Content disposal instead of provider code; no general draft expiry, legal-hold product or request-history deletion.
Acceptance requires actual scoped API/database contract and race/crash/retry evidence;
shared children prove with a restricted fixture caller, Leave children with real draft
state. Required delivery ATDD/TDD precedes implementation. No runtime proof is claimed.

### Candidate Story 4.12-S: Reclaim abandoned uploads using existing Content fences

**Status:** Technical boundary candidate for consolidated planning review. Owner: Content.
**Predecessors:** 4.4-S, 4.11-S. Original parent criteria remain binding as allocated below.

As the Content operator,
I want to reconcile abandoned upload and staging objects through the existing disposal lifecycle,
So that interrupted transfer data is reclaimed without breaking saved attachments.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** expired, cancelled, failed or finalized-never-attached upload work,
**When** abandonment is assessed,
**Then** Content uses actual capability/lifecycle and authoritative operation/reference evidence, with bounded reconciliation of uncertain confirmation; age alone is insufficient.

**Given** a confirmed reference or valid in-flight protection,
**When** cleanup is considered,
**Then** the existing reference/disposal fence preserves bytes and denies reclamation until a valid release or resolved non-commit.

**Given** upload completion, renewal, sealing or confirmation races with reclamation,
**When** the same lifecycle resolves,
**Then** only one valid outcome wins and delayed bytes cannot make abandoned identity ready again; leftover provider bytes remain discoverable for repeated cleanup.

**Given** sealed verified bytes plus leftover staging data,
**When** staging cleanup runs,
**Then** only redundant staging is removed and fixed identity plus supported recovery remain intact.

**Given** failed/uncertain deletion or a stalled backlog,
**When** recovery runs,
**Then** the existing disposal operation/restricted worker provides truthful completion, bounded retries and operational escalation rather than another cleanup engine.

**Traceability / planned verification and size:** 4.12/AC01–07 shared machinery. One eligibility/discovery extension over 4.4-S/4.11-S with provider late-upload/staging fixtures. Does not add Leave domain rules, scanner/OCR, draft expiry or another deletion worker.
Acceptance requires actual scoped API/database contract and race/crash/retry evidence;
shared children prove with a restricted fixture caller, Leave children with real draft
state. Required delivery ATDD/TDD precedes implementation. No runtime proof is claimed.

**Impacts:** Scaffold: prove/promote only the neutral client/worker/fixture delta with
the first owner; keep generated adapters synchronized. Shared UI: reuse existing accurate
attachment states, with no employee-facing lease/cleanup controls. Agent context: current
owner/HTTP/privacy/lifecycle instructions suffice. Documentation: owning protocol, source

### Candidate Story 4.12-L: Protect saved Leave attachments during abandonment recovery

**Status:** Technical boundary candidate for consolidated planning review. Owner: Leave.
**Predecessors:** 4.4-L, 4.12-S. Original parent criteria remain binding as allocated below.

As an employee,
I want to keep saved draft attachments protected while interrupted attachment attempts recover,
So that cleanup cannot mistake my saved input for an abandoned upload.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a Content reconciliation request for an exact Leave association operation,
**When** the registered scoped service asks for its outcome,
**Then** Leave verifies application/organization/content/operation bindings and resolves committed association versus terminal non-commit under its local lifecycle guard, without exposing draft text or broad search.

**Given** a saved draft, request or uncertain attachment commit,
**When** cleanup recovery inspects the owner outcome,
**Then** the actual durable association remains protected; timeout and missing Content-local rows cannot stand in for Leave evidence.

**Given** an expired pending operation and a delayed confirm/discard/retry,
**When** Leave reconciles them concurrently,
**Then** one durable committed or terminal outcome wins; late attempts cannot resurrect the closed operation, attach reclaimed identity or overwrite newer draft input.

**Given** owner outage, unresolved protection or a confirmed missing object,
**When** recovery exceeds its declared budget,
**Then** restricted operations can reconcile it with audit/alerts, and the employee sees accurate existing attachment recovery feedback without technical lease controls.

**Traceability / planned verification and size:** 4.12/AC02–04 and AC07 actual Leave integration; 4.12-S owns provider eligibility/deletion and AC01/05/06. One small outcome/reconciliation adapter and real saved-draft race proof using 4.4-L state; no second cleanup engine or E5 submission implementation.
Acceptance requires actual scoped API/database contract and race/crash/retry evidence;
shared children prove with a restricted fixture caller, Leave children with real draft
state. Required delivery ATDD/TDD precedes implementation. No runtime proof is claimed.
